chunks.chineseText:
地从信纸上收回目光。果然，神谕不是所有人都能看懂的。

他的视线投向秦琅。秦琅将信纸一页一页地翻过，那副仿佛傀儡般僵硬冰冷的脸上出现了生动的嫌弃表情。

罗兰眼皮子一抖。面前这人居然像个活人了？

他试探地问道：“神有什么命令吗？”

秦琅头也不抬道：“不是神的命令，是我同伴的信。”

话语含义很简单，但罗兰没听懂：“啊？”

秦琅：“我同伴的信。”

罗兰：“……”啊？！刚刚我不是幻听吗？？

神大费周折让黑暗神殿举行神降仪式，就是给你送你同伴的信？！

罗兰极力压制声线的颤抖：“请问……请问您的同伴是什么身份？”

秦琅抬起头，如正常人般笑了一下：“没什么身份，就是个傻子。”

他的手指轻轻地摩挲着信纸。

夏兮风原本没有写日记的习惯。他写这本日记，是想让自己安心。

秦琅不是第一次和夏兮风分离。他们选择了一南一北不同的大学，每次分别都是近半年。

夏兮风认为以前不需要，现在需要吗？

秦琅不知为何，想起夏兮风无意识嘀咕的那句“男朋友”。

“请问你知道轻风镇如何去吗？”秦琅礼貌地问道。他将轻风镇所处大概位置告诉了罗兰。

罗兰奇怪地发现，这次秦琅礼貌的表情居然没让他产生不适感，好像变成一个正常的有礼貌的人似的。

轻风镇看似不起眼，但罗兰还真的知道：“光明教会的苦修士约翰神父隐居的轻风镇？我知道。”

秦琅问道：“约翰神父是很有名的人吗？”

约翰神父在上一次黑暗与光明的战争中声名远播，居然会有人不知道？罗兰很疑惑，但还是如实回答：“是的，他已经被预定死后必定进入光明神的殿堂，成为一位神侍。”

秦琅道：“应该就是那里。”

罗兰摇头：“轻风镇在光明教国。魔族不能进入光明教国。”

秦琅：“我不是魔族。”

罗兰睁大眼睛：“什么？！”黑暗圣子怎么可能不是魔族？！

秦琅收起日记本：“请帮我规划路线，等到了光明教国边界，我自己前往。你可以返回。”

任务这么快就能结束吗？罗兰不敢置信：“好。”

秦琅：“魔界有什么能带去光明教国的特产吗？”

罗兰又以为自己幻听了：“特产？”

秦琅看着一箱子装备、药水和金币：“嗯。”

接到书信前，秦琅心底黑暗翻腾，被理性牢牢锁住。

分别后记载了夏兮风每一天详细生活的日记，如阳光般照进心底，黑暗退潮，好像他正在谈一个很正常的恋爱。

“如果没有回礼，他会很吵。”秦琅道。

罗兰恍然大悟：“难道您的同伴，是您的爱人？”

秦琅：“……”

他看向箱子，沉默了一瞬，才回答道：“嗯。”

罗兰瞬间放下心来，语气轻快不少：“请放心，魔界也有许多光明教国的商队喜欢的货物！很多特产都能带去光明教国！”

原来圣子不是想要毁灭世界，而是和爱人失散心情不好？那就难怪了。谁弄丢了爱人的行踪，心情都不好啊。圣子力量增长那么快，说不准只是因为意外失去了力量，恢复起来才那么快。他只是想赶紧找回力量去寻找爱人，不是什么被设定的杀戮怪物。

罗兰感觉整个世界都光明了起来。

虽然他是虔诚的黑暗信徒。

……

“只能一个月通信一次吗？不能每天都给秦琅送东西吗？”夏兮风对着教堂的神像嘀嘀咕咕。

虽然光明神无法与夏兮风即时聊天，但能感知到夏兮风的嘀咕。

祂坐在神座之上，单手托腮。

夏兮风真的是完全对神灵一点敬意都没有。但不知道为何，祂很喜欢夏兮风对待祂的态度。

光明神被神皇创造出来的时候，象征着一切美好的品德，本身就是“美”的规则的具现化。

除了规则上与祂对立的黑暗神，即使是同位格的神灵也会被祂的“美”吸引，很难与祂正常交流。

而黑暗神……唉，性格不合，别说聊天，看着就头疼，实在是不想提。

没想到一个凡人居然能和自己很自然地聊天。

“他真的只是普通的凡人吗？”光明神想起曾经遇到的外来神灵，自言自语。

那位外来神灵也不会被祂的“美”迷惑。但……唉，那个外来神灵见到稍微好看一点的生灵，就要询问是否能来一段露水姻缘，即使只要拒绝，那位外来神灵就不会纠缠，还算能够正常交流，光明神还是不想认可祂为朋友。

还是性格不合。

光明神看着夏兮风嘀咕完之后，就拿出一堆石板，说要“升级”破旧的小教堂。

约翰神父在一旁宠溺地看着夏兮风，任由他对小教堂敲敲打打。小教堂的地板、墙壁、屋顶神奇地换了新模样。这位虔诚的狂信徒苦修士，竟然还同意夏兮风对神像动手。

光明神犹豫了一下。在新的神像建造好的时候，祂丢了一缕神力进去。

神像发光，一只白底金纹的小兽漂浮在神像前面。

这是光明神在外来神的帮助下修炼的，还不成熟的新的投影法术。

这个投影没有任何战斗的力量，只能寄存祂一缕神魂，维持需要大量神力。

祂有点心虚。

神皇几乎不关注这个世界，只有定下的规定被破坏时才会降下神罚。下次黑暗和光明之争还需要一百年，祂浪费一点神力也没关系吧？

“嗨！我就知道升级教堂一定会有奖励！”夏兮风笑着把小兽抱在怀中。

小兽的脑袋轮廓有点像幼龙，浑身毛绒绒的，身后是一对白色羽毛翅膀，尾巴如狮子一般有一个圆圆的毛球。

小兽抓着一个只有夏兮风拳头大小的小袋子，不自在地在夏兮风怀里扭了扭。

夏兮风双目瞳孔中有针尖般的金光一闪而过，小兽脑袋上浮现出状态栏。

【种族：光明神投影

血量：100

法力：100

法术：看见祂的小背包了吗？能装进祂的小背包里的东西，都能传送哦。】

夏兮风问道：“能聊天吗？”

小兽睁开眼：“咩。”能。

光明神的声音在夏兮风脑海里响起。夏兮风被小兽仿佛小羊般的叫声逗乐了。

“嗯……给你取个假名字，叫维希好不好？维希就是希望的意思。”夏兮风笑道：“谢谢！我给你做好吃的！”

在神界上为自己突发奇想羞窘不安，正准备中断法术的光明神一愣。这凡人居然还为神灵取名？

祂这一愣，夏兮风已经拿出一个蜂蜜小蛋糕，塞到了小兽嘴里。

一个月过去了，他不仅新开辟了小麦和土豆田，还开辟了能做红药的止血花田和能做蓝药的宁神花田，并在花田里放置了蜂巢

牲畜棚也已经建造完毕。他养了许多鸡鸭牛羊，每天忙得脚不沾地，期盼系统什么时候开放帮工功能。
chunks.englishText:
He withdrew his gaze from the letter. As expected, not everyone could decipher the divine oracle.

His eyes shifted to Qin Lang. As Qin Lang flipped through the pages of the letter, the stiff, icy expression that usually made him look like a puppet vanished, replaced by a vivid look of disdain.

Roland’s eyelids twitched. Was the man in front of him actually acting like a living person?

He tentatively asked, "Does the God have any orders?"

Qin Lang didn't even look up. "It’s not an order from a God. It’s a letter from my companion."

The meaning of the words was simple, but Roland didn't grasp it: "Huh?"

Qin Lang: "A letter from my companion."

Roland: "..." Huh?! Was I not hallucinating just now??

The God went to such great lengths to have the Temple of Darkness hold a divine descent ceremony, just to deliver a letter from your companion?!

Roland tried his best to suppress the tremor in his voice: "May I ask... what is your companion's status?"

Qin Lang looked up and smiled, just like a normal person: "No special status. Just an idiot."

His fingers gently stroked the letter paper.

Xia Xifeng didn't originally have the habit of keeping a diary. He wrote this diary to put his own mind at ease.

This wasn't the first time Qin Lang and Xia Xifeng had been separated. They had chosen different universities in the north and south, and each time they parted, it was for nearly half a year.

Xia Xifeng thought he didn't need one before, but did he need one now?

For some reason, Qin Lang recalled that phrase Xia Xifeng would mutter unconsciously: "boyfriend."

"May I ask if you know how to get to Breeze Town?" Qin Lang asked politely. He told Roland the approximate location of Breeze Town.

Roland found it strange that Qin Lang’s polite expression this time didn't make him feel uncomfortable; it was as if he had truly become a normal, courteous person.

Breeze Town seemed unremarkable, but Roland actually knew it: "The Breeze Town where Father John, the ascetic priest of the Church of Light, lives in seclusion? I know it."

Qin Lang asked, "Is Father John a very famous person?"

Father John had been renowned since the last war between Darkness and Light. How could someone not know him? Roland was puzzled, but answered truthfully: "Yes, he has already been destined to enter the halls of the God of Light after his death and become a divine attendant."

Qin Lang said, "That should be the place."

Roland shook his head: "Breeze Town is in the Light Theocracy. The Demon Race cannot enter the Light Theocracy."

Qin Lang: "I am not of the Demon Race."

Roland’s eyes widened: "What?!" How could the Son of Darkness not be of the Demon Race?!

Qin Lang put away the diary: "Please help me plan the route. Once I reach the border of the Light Theocracy, I will proceed on my own. You may return."

Could the mission really end so quickly? Roland couldn't believe it: "Alright."

Qin Lang: "Are there any local specialties from the Demon Realm that I can take to the Light Theocracy?"

Roland thought he was hallucinating again: "Specialties?"

Qin Lang looked at the crate full of equipment, potions, and gold coins: "Yes."

Before receiving the letter, Qin Lang’s inner darkness had been churning, held firmly in check only by his rationality.

The diary, which recorded every detail of Xia Xifeng’s daily life after their separation, shone into his heart like sunlight. The darkness receded, as if he were currently in a perfectly normal relationship.

"If there is no return gift, he will be very noisy," Qin Lang said.

Roland suddenly realized: "Could it be that your companion is your lover?"

Qin Lang: "..."

He looked at the crate and remained silent for a moment before answering: "Yes."

Roland’s heart instantly settled, and his tone became much lighter: "Please rest assured, the Demon Realm has many goods that merchants from the Light Theocracy enjoy! Many specialties can be brought into the Light Theocracy!"

So the Saint wasn't trying to destroy the world, but was just in a bad mood because he was separated from his lover? That made sense. Anyone who lost track of their lover would be in a bad mood. The Saint’s power had grown so quickly; perhaps it was just because he had accidentally lost his power and was recovering it rapidly. He just wanted to regain his strength quickly to find his lover, not because he was some programmed killing monster.

Roland felt the whole world brighten up.

Even though he was a devout believer of Darkness.

...

"Can we only communicate once a month? Can't I send things to Qin Lang every day?" Xia Xifeng muttered to the statue in the church.

Although the God of Light could not chat with Xia Xifeng in real-time, He could perceive Xia Xifeng’s muttering.

He sat upon the divine throne, resting His chin on one hand.

Xia Xifeng truly had no reverence for deities at all. But for some reason, He quite liked the way Xia Xifeng treated Him.

When the God of Light was created by the God Emperor, He symbolized all beautiful virtues and was, in Himself, the embodiment of the rule of "Beauty."

Except for the God of Darkness, who was diametrically opposed to Him by rule, even deities of the same standing would be attracted by His "Beauty," making it difficult to communicate with Him normally.

And the God of Darkness... sigh, their personalities were incompatible. Let alone chatting, just looking at Him gave Him a headache; He really didn't want to mention it.

He hadn't expected a mortal to be able to chat with Him so naturally.

"Is he really just an ordinary mortal?" The God of Light recalled the foreign deities He had encountered before and muttered to Himself.

That foreign deity wouldn't be bewitched by His "Beauty." But... sigh, that foreign deity would ask any creature that looked even slightly good-looking if they could have a fleeting romance. Even though the foreign deity wouldn't pester you if you refused, and could communicate normally, the God of Light still didn't want to acknowledge Him as a friend.

Still, their personalities were incompatible.

The God of Light watched as Xia Xifeng finished muttering and took out a pile of stone slabs, saying he wanted to "upgrade" the dilapidated little church.

Father John watched Xia Xifeng dotingly from the side, letting him hammer and tinker with the little church. The floors, walls, and roof of the little church miraculously took on a new look. This devout, fanatical ascetic priest had actually agreed to let Xia Xifeng work on the statue of the God.

The God of Light hesitated for a moment. When the new statue was built, He cast a wisp of divine power into it.

The statue glowed, and a small beast with white fur and gold patterns floated in front of it.

This was a new, immature projection spell He had been practicing with the help of a foreign deity.

This projection had no combat power and could only house a wisp of His divine soul; maintaining it required a massive amount of divine power.

He felt a little guilty.

The God Emperor rarely paid attention to this world, only descending divine punishment when established rules were broken. The next war between Darkness and Light wasn't for another hundred years; it shouldn't matter if He wasted a little divine power, right?

"Hi! I knew there would be rewards for upgrading the church!" Xia Xifeng smiled and scooped the little beast into his arms.

The little beast’s head outline looked somewhat like a young dragon; it was fluffy all over, with a pair of white feathered wings on its back, and its tail had a round, fluffy ball like a lion’s.

The little beast was clutching a small bag only the size of Xia Xifeng’s fist, and it squirmed uncomfortably in his arms.

A golden light like a needle tip flashed across Xia Xifeng’s pupils, and a status bar appeared above the little beast’s head.

【Race: Projection of the God of Light】
【HP: 100】
【Mana: 100】
【Spell: See His little backpack? Anything that can fit into His little backpack can be teleported.】

Xia Xifeng asked: "Can we chat?"

The little beast opened its eyes: "Baa." Yes.

The voice of the God of Light echoed in Xia Xifeng’s mind. Xia Xifeng was amused by the little beast’s sheep-like bleat.

"Hmm... let’s give you a fake name. How about 'Vixi'? Vixi means hope," Xia Xifeng laughed. "Thank you! I’ll make you something delicious!"

The God of Light, who was feeling embarrassed and uneasy in the Divine Realm for His impulsive whim and was just about to interrupt the spell, was stunned. This mortal was actually naming a deity?

In His moment of hesitation, Xia Xifeng had already taken out a honey cupcake and stuffed it into the little beast’s mouth.

A month had passed. He had not only cleared new fields for wheat and potatoes, but also fields for hemostatic flowers to make red potions and calming flowers to make blue potions, and had placed beehives in the flower fields.

The livestock shed had also been completed. He raised many chickens, ducks, cows, and sheep, and was so busy every day that he didn't have a moment to rest, looking forward to when the system would open the helper function.

chunks.chineseText:
只要够肝，他的小日子是越过越美好，只差秦琅回来。就算系统不开放帮工功能，按照“战友”设定，秦琅肯定能给自己当帮工，获得的经验值不会衰减。

小兽眨了眨眼睛，惊讶地发现，蛋糕味道居然不错。

身为天生的神灵，祂只能食用神域中出产的食物。凡人的食物对祂而言都有一股难言的怪味。

神灵很少吃东西，也不会饥饿。祂只会偶尔吃一点富含神力的水果，喝一点水果酿造的美酒。

那位外来神说神灵可以压制神力吃凡人的食物，品尝凡人能尝到的味道。但这个世界不会有神灵做这样的事，浪费神力品尝凡人的食物，怎么想都很蠢。

“好吃。”小兽在夏兮风脑海里道。

夏兮风笑得眼睛弯弯如月牙：“喜欢就好。走，今天我不干活了，我把会做的菜都做一遍，看你喜欢吃什么！”

好不容易回过神的约翰神父道：“这、这位神兽是……”

夏兮风一手抱着小兽，一手竖起食指立在嘴唇前：“嘘，不可说哦。”

约翰神父立刻严肃道：“是。”

小兽仰头看着夏兮风。夏兮风好像很会装神秘？自己越来越好奇他的来历了。

……

秦琅花了一天时间购物。

在得到夏兮风给的装备时，他的装备栏解锁。与在梦世界时一样，他不仅可以一键换装，还能买普通的衣服当作时装“套”在装备上，让装备隐形。

夏兮风制造的锁链甲和精铁剑不仅比商城里卖的基础数值高，还带有百分之三十全属性上升的套装效果。

秦琅实力大增，可以挑战更强力的怪物，花一天时间逛街也不会影响升级效率。

秦琅购完物，在当地黑暗教会中借住，省一点旅店钱。在罗兰向黑暗之神的神像祷告的时候，他礼貌地和神像打了声招呼，感谢黑暗之神帮忙送快递。

神像发光了。

一只白色的小兽从神像中飞了出来。

秦琅：“？”

小兽：“夏兮风给你的旅费。每天送一次。”

祂把小背包开口朝下抖了抖，抖落一小把金银铜币和一封信。

秦琅：“？？”

他捡起信。夏兮风在信中说，以后他们每天都能写信聊天，并且每天都会送来金币、银币、铜币各一百枚，免得秦琅没地方换零钱。

夏兮风：背包里一共能塞五百枚金币，如果钱不够用，就写信问我要，我去凑！

秦琅看向小兽。

小兽看着秦琅的双眼中，不知道为何有一丝紧张。

秦琅什么都没问，挑挑拣拣刚能塞进背包里的特产，将背包塞满特产有又塞了一封已经写好的信，一并递给了小兽：“辛苦了。”

小兽：“不辛苦。”祂身形一闪，消失了。

站在一旁的罗兰这才回过神，结结巴巴道：“那、那是什么？怎么身上具有浓厚的光明气息？！”

秦琅幽幽一叹，没说话。

夏兮风“鉴定”过的事物，他也能看到鉴定后的状态栏。

光明神不仅送快递，还捏了个投影给夏兮风当邮递员跟宠？！

这合理吗？！

作者有话要说：

【夏兮风预判了秦琅的黑化，及时释放技能“日记本交换”打断秦琅黑化读条。】

有一种爱叫什么锅配什么盖，你想要的偏执控制都OK。这怎么不叫一种健康的恋爱呢？[竖耳兔头]
chunks.englishText:
As long as he worked hard enough, his little life was getting better and better, with only Qin Lang’s return missing. Even if the system didn't open the helper function, according to the "comrade-in-arms" setting, Qin Lang would definitely be able to act as his helper, and the experience points gained wouldn't diminish.

The little beast blinked, surprised to find that the cake actually tasted quite good.

As a natural deity, He could only consume food produced in the Divine Realm. Mortal food had an indescribable, strange taste to Him.

Deities rarely ate, nor did they feel hunger. He would only occasionally eat fruit rich in divine power or drink a little wine brewed from fruits.

That foreign deity said that deities could suppress their divine power to eat mortal food and taste what mortals could taste. But no deity in this world would do such a thing; wasting divine power to taste mortal food seemed stupid no matter how you looked at it.

"Delicious," the little beast said in Xia Xifeng’s mind.

Xia Xifeng’s eyes curved like crescent moons: "I’m glad you like it. Come on, I won’t work today. I’ll cook every dish I know how to make and see what you like!"

Father John, who had finally regained his senses, said: "T-this divine beast is..."

Xia Xifeng held the little beast in one hand and raised a finger to his lips with the other: "Shh, it’s a secret."

Father John immediately said solemnly: "Understood."

The little beast looked up at Xia Xifeng. Xia Xifeng seemed very good at acting mysterious. He was becoming increasingly curious about his origins.

...

Qin Lang spent a day shopping.

When he received the equipment given by Xia Xifeng, his equipment slot unlocked. Just like in the Dream World, he could not only change outfits with one click, but also buy ordinary clothes as "skins" to wear over his equipment, making the actual gear invisible.

The chainmail and refined iron sword crafted by Xia Xifeng not only had higher base stats than those sold in the mall, but also carried a set effect of a 30% increase in all attributes.

Qin Lang’s strength increased greatly, allowing him to challenge more powerful monsters, and spending a day shopping wouldn't affect his leveling efficiency.

After finishing his shopping, Qin Lang stayed in the local Church of Darkness to save a little money on hotels. When Roland was praying to the statue of the God of Darkness, he politely greeted the statue, thanking the God of Darkness for helping deliver the package.

The statue glowed.

A small white beast flew out from the statue.

Qin Lang: "?"

The little beast: "Travel expenses from Xia Xifeng. Delivered once a day."

He tilted the opening of his small backpack downward, shaking out a small handful of gold, silver, and copper coins and a letter.

Qin Lang: "??"

He picked up the letter. Xia Xifeng said in the letter that they could write to each other every day from now on, and he would send one hundred gold, silver, and copper coins each day so that Qin Lang wouldn't have to worry about finding change.

Xia Xifeng: The backpack can hold a total of five hundred gold coins. If the money isn't enough, just write and ask me, I’ll scrape some together!

Qin Lang looked at the little beast.

For some reason, there was a hint of nervousness in the little beast’s eyes as he looked at Qin Lang.

Qin Lang didn't ask anything. He picked and chose local specialties that could just fit into the backpack, filled it up, and then handed it back to the little beast along with a letter he had already written: "Thank you for your hard work."

The little beast: "It’s no trouble." His figure flashed and disappeared.

Roland, who was standing to the side, finally came to his senses and stammered: "W-what was that? Why did it have such a thick aura of Light on it?!"

Qin Lang sighed gloomily and didn't speak.

He could also see the status bar of items after Xia Xifeng had "identified" them.

The God of Light was not only delivering mail, but had also molded a projection to serve as Xia Xifeng’s courier pet?!

Is this reasonable?!

Author's Note:

【Xia Xifeng anticipated Qin Lang’s corruption and timely released the skill "Diary Exchange" to interrupt Qin Lang’s corruption casting bar.】

There is a kind of love called "every pot has its lid"; the obsessive control you want is all okay. Why isn't this a healthy relationship? [Rabbit ears]

chunks.chineseText:
第122章 一章半合一

秦琅遇到了更不合理的事。

第二天前来送东西的快递员，变成了一只黑色的小兽。

秦琅看着黑色小兽。

黑色小兽盯着秦琅。

黑色小兽嘴里叫着“咩咩咩”，熟悉的声音在秦琅脑海里响起：“总不能老让光明神从我的神像里出来，那我多没面子。”

秦琅：“……”你来当这个快递员，就很有面子？

黑暗神确实这么想的。让光明神偷偷来到祂的神域，祂再捏个投影把东西送给秦琅，确实比光明神在魔界来去自如有面子。

秦琅沉默地接过今天的快递，把东西塞进黑色小兽的背包里。

黑色小兽：“光明神有蛋糕，我没有吗？”

秦琅：“我不会做。”

黑色小兽没好气道：“你不会告诉你家夏兮风，让他给我也备一份好吃的？我还没吃过凡间的食物呢！”

秦琅只好在信里添了一句。

夏兮风接到秦琅的信时，刚好听光明神抱怨完黑暗神脑子有病。

再想起秦琅信里对黑暗神的介绍，夏兮风笑得直不起腰。

秦琅在信里对黑暗神的忽男忽女表达了疑惑，夏兮风询问光明神，光明神说那是因为神灵没有性别的缘故。

如梦世界诞生的生灵还未出现前的概念神一样，祂们最初没有性别之分。如太阳的性别是太阳，水神的性别是一大坨海蓝色果冻。祂们在接触了人类之后，才会让自己的神体或者投影有了性别，不过这性别也是可以随时改的。

比如诞生之日和希望之日此次的神眷者是男性，祂们的声音便是男性；水神的声音、身体都是拷贝的辛格的前世；世界树曾经是男性的精灵族永恒皇帝，但现在的声音和形象都是慈祥的女性母亲……

自我、智慧等生灵诞生后才出生的概念神灵，虽然有喜爱使用的性别，性别也可以随时更换，比如智慧变成美女对水神骗身骗命。只有龙神等所有从后天生灵进化的神灵，神魂的性别才是固定的。

光明和黑暗既然是这个世界最初的概念神，自然性别也无从谈起。

不过没有性别，和忽男忽女差距也挺大的吧？这明明和神灵的特质无关，只是黑暗神自身的恶趣味。

光明神深以为然。

祂还提起了自己性别的选择。原本祂不是这个形象，当某位外神到来的时候向祂求一睡，祂赶紧变成男性，外神说男的也没问题，祂才换成了现在这个完全没有性征的身体。

夏兮风想起来，不小心看到的光明神洗澡时的身体，确实上下性征都没有，估计连排泄器官都没有。

他看着光明神的庆幸神情，尴尬地笑了笑。

以他对龙神的了解，其实没有性征，龙神那只超级种龙也是可以的。龙神最后没有再求欢，只是从光明神两度变换性别中感受到光明神坚定的拒绝而已。没想到光明神真以为这样的身体能减轻自己美丽的魅惑，便一直用下去了。

光明神仍旧对自己的选择非常得意。祂以为能出现夏兮风这样无视他的美丽的特殊凡人，一定是因为祂没有性别的缘故。

夏兮风把光明神又一个呆呆的事迹分享给秦琅，顺带空出一半背包给黑暗神带零食。

除了光明神的“诙谐”事迹，夏兮风还向秦琅描述了轻风镇形形色/色的人。

正直的男爵，慈爱的神父，热情的镇民，连来往的客商和佣兵都诚信又讲义气。虽然也有罪恶发生，但很快就会受到惩罚。

贵族与平民一起劳作，魔法师和战士们保护着城镇安全，孩子们能在街道上尽情玩耍。

夏兮风故意露出了自己神奇的耕作天赋，如他这样能带来大批粮食的“魔法师”，本该被很多野心家招纳。教皇国的王族和高级神职者只是隐藏身份来拜访他，唯一的愿望只是如果其他人也能学习，希望他教导其他人耕种的方法，他们将给予对等的报酬。

光明教皇国向来在各种西幻世界观的作品中充当伪君子反派，这里的光明真的是“光明磊落”的光明。

如同童话一般。

夏兮风信中的内容轻松愉快，他的生活似乎越来越幸福快乐，秦琅的眉头却越皱越紧。

这倒不是什么自己不在夏兮风身边，却有人抢占了夏兮风的注意力，或者夏兮风没和自己重聚也充满快乐的偏执想法。

当两人联系上后，如果不是秦琅要在魔界多刷点经验，多攒点夏兮风可能会用上的魔界特产，他可以很快赶回去——罗兰的聚怪能力，只有在魔界才能用。

他们会因为不知道对方的安危而惊惧不安，但一旦知道了对方很安全，每天都能通信，并且随时可以回到对方身边时，分别就不是别离，不用焦虑。

秦琅焦虑的是，夏兮风对这个世界投入了感情。

他曾经说夏兮风没有边界感，但他很清楚，夏兮风只是对他没有边界感。

夏兮风很容易交到朋友，但想成为他“朋友”却也不容易。就算成为朋友，夏兮风也不会太过侵入别人的私生活，更不会嘲笑别人的私事。

他对人的直觉很敏锐，与人交往时很理智，有“大爱”但不会被“小爱”左右，与苏尔先生一样是天生的救世主。

所以当夏兮风嘲笑光明神的呆萌，便是把光明神纳入了私交范围，认可光明神为朋友。

即使夏兮风再理智，朋友和陌生人是不同的。

当外神侵入梦世界，两个世界的规则相撞，终点已经固定——这个世界注定被它的创世神毁灭，成为掠夺梦世界规则的武器。

即使他们可能回到了过去，但命运线已经收缩，注定的结局不会改变。

哪怕他们回到梦世界的过去，也只能改变没有被太阳注视的结局，拨动没有人见证的命运。而这个世界的命运是它的创世神亲自注视着，谁也不能更改。

黑暗之神已经死在梦世界的自我之神和死亡之神手中，碎片融入了自我之神的神格，成为了秦琅第一个神话级装备。

光明之神已经被龙神毁灭，死亡后身上的诅咒顺着祂和祂的创世神的联系，侵入了敌对创世神的身体，对敌对创世神造成了伤害——因为这一击，系统才能把夏兮风和秦琅“偷渡”到这个世界。

秦琅很清楚，这个世界和他们遇见的黑暗神、光明神，都只是破灭前的残影。

系统没有给予细致的任务，只让他们见证世界的破灭。

秦琅一直以为，这个任务是让他们重走一遍成神的道路，夯实基础，将系统赋予的力量化为己用，拥有真正的神灵的力量。

见证破灭，可能也是成长的一环——要成为超脱者，这样的见识不可缺少。

他和夏兮风应该以旁观者的身份悄悄潜伏在这个世界，游离在所有人的生活之外。

秦琅不会对这个世界投入感情。

他相信夏兮风不蠢，有自知之明，也会克制住对这个世界投入感情。

但夏兮风仿佛是主动接触这个世界，主动和这个世界建立联系，甚至主动引导光明神和黑暗神与他建立友谊。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 122: One and a Half Chapters Combined (Part 1)

Qin Lang encountered something even more unreasonable.

The next day, the courier who came to deliver items had turned into a small black beast.

Qin Lang looked at the small black beast.

The small black beast stared at Qin Lang.

The small black beast bleated "baa baa baa," and a familiar voice echoed in Qin Lang’s mind: "I can’t always let the God of Light come out of my statue; that would be too embarrassing for me."

Qin Lang: "..." And you coming to be this courier is very dignified?

The God of Darkness did indeed think so. Letting the God of Light sneak into His Divine Realm, and then having Him mold a projection to send things to Qin Lang, was indeed more dignified than the God of Light coming and going as He pleased in the Demon Realm.

Qin Lang silently accepted today’s delivery and stuffed the items into the small black beast’s backpack.

The small black beast: "The God of Light has cake; don't I?"

Qin Lang: "I don't know how to make it."

The small black beast said indignantly: "Can't you tell your Xia Xifeng to prepare a portion for me too? I’ve never eaten mortal food before!"

Qin Lang had no choice but to add a line in his letter.

When Xia Xifeng received Qin Lang’s letter, he happened to be listening to the God of Light complaining about the God of Darkness being crazy.

Recalling Qin Lang’s description of the God of Darkness in the letter, Xia Xifeng laughed so hard he couldn't stand straight.

Qin Lang had expressed confusion in his letter about the God of Darkness being sometimes male and sometimes female. Xia Xifeng asked the God of Light, and the God of Light said it was because deities had no gender.

Like the conceptual deities that existed before the birth of creatures in the Dream World, they initially had no distinction of gender. For example, the gender of the Sun was "Sun," and the gender of the Water God was a giant blob of sea-blue jelly. They only allowed their divine bodies or projections to have a gender after coming into contact with humans, but this gender could be changed at any time.

For instance, the divine chosen ones of the Day of Birth and the Day of Hope were male, so their voices were male; the Water God’s voice and body were copied from Singer’s past life; the World Tree was once a male Eternal Emperor of the Elven race, but now its voice and image were that of a kind, motherly female...

Conceptual deities born after the birth of self-aware and intelligent creatures, although they had genders they preferred to use, could change them at any time—for example, Wisdom turned into a beautiful woman to deceive the Water God of his body and life. Only deities who evolved from acquired creatures, like the Dragon God, had fixed genders for their divine souls.

Since Light and Darkness were the original conceptual deities of this world, there was naturally no talk of gender.

However, having no gender and being "sometimes male, sometimes female" were quite different, right? This clearly had nothing to do with the nature of deities; it was just the God of Darkness’s own bad taste.

The God of Light agreed deeply.

He even brought up His own choice of gender. He didn't originally have this image. When a certain foreign deity arrived and begged to sleep with Him, He hurriedly turned into a male. The foreign deity said that male was also fine, so He changed into His current body, which had absolutely no sexual characteristics.

Xia Xifeng remembered the body he had accidentally seen when the God of Light was bathing; it truly had no sexual characteristics at all, and he guessed it probably didn't even have excretory organs.

He looked at the God of Light’s relieved expression and smiled awkwardly.

Based on his understanding of the Dragon God, even without sexual characteristics, that super-species dragon could still have managed. The Dragon God didn't pursue it further in the end, simply sensing the God of Light’s firm refusal through the two changes in gender. He hadn't expected the God of Light to actually believe that such a body could reduce the charm of His beauty, and thus He had kept it ever since.

The God of Light was still very proud of His choice. He believed that the reason a special mortal like Xia Xifeng could appear and ignore His beauty was definitely because He had no gender.

Xia Xifeng shared another one of the God of Light’s silly deeds with Qin Lang, and incidentally cleared out half of the backpack for the God of Darkness to bring snacks.

In addition to the "witty" deeds of the God of Light, Xia Xifeng also described the colorful people of Breeze Town to Qin Lang.

The upright Baron, the compassionate priest, the enthusiastic townspeople, and even the passing merchants and mercenaries were honest and loyal. Although crimes occurred, they were quickly punished.

Nobles and commoners worked together, mages and warriors protected the town’s safety, and children could play to their hearts' content in the streets.

Xia Xifeng deliberately revealed his magical farming talent. A "mage" like him, who could bring in large amounts of grain, should have been recruited by many ambitious people. The royalty and high-ranking clergy of the Theocracy only visited him while hiding their identities, and their only wish was that if others could learn, they hoped he would teach them the methods of farming, for which they would provide equal compensation.

The Light Theocracy had always acted as hypocritical villains in various Western fantasy works, but the "Light" here was truly "open and aboveboard" Light.

It was like a fairy tale.

The content of Xia Xifeng’s letters was relaxed and happy; his life seemed to be getting happier and happier, yet Qin Lang’s brows furrowed tighter and tighter.

This wasn't because of any paranoid thought that someone was stealing Xia Xifeng’s attention while he wasn't there, or that Xia Xifeng was full of joy without him.

Once the two were in contact, if it weren't for Qin Lang needing to grind more experience in the Demon Realm and save up more Demon Realm specialties that Xia Xifeng might need, he could have returned very quickly—Roland’s ability to gather monsters was only useful in the Demon Realm.

They would be terrified and uneasy because they didn't know if the other was safe, but once they knew the other was safe, could communicate every day, and could return to the other’s side at any time, separation was no longer parting; there was no need for anxiety.

What Qin Lang was anxious about was that Xia Xifeng was investing emotions into this world.

He had once said that Xia Xifeng lacked boundaries, but he knew very well that Xia Xifeng only lacked boundaries with him.

Xia Xifeng made friends easily, but it wasn't easy to become his "friend." Even if they became friends, Xia Xifeng wouldn't intrude too much into others' private lives, nor would he mock others' private affairs.

His intuition about people was sharp, he was rational when interacting with others, and he had "great love" but wouldn't be swayed by "small love." Like Mr. Suer, he was a natural savior.

Therefore, when Xia Xifeng mocked the God of Light’s silliness, it meant he had included the God of Light in his circle of private friends and acknowledged Him as a friend.

Even if Xia Xifeng was rational, friends and strangers were different.

When foreign deities invaded the Dream World and the rules of the two worlds collided, the end was already fixed—this world was destined to be destroyed by its creator god and become a weapon to plunder the rules of the Dream World.

Even if they might have returned to the past, the timeline had already contracted, and the destined ending would not change.

Even if they returned to the past of the Dream World, they could only change the ending that wasn't witnessed by the Sun, and nudge the fate that no one had seen. But the fate of this world was personally watched by its creator god; no one could change it.

The God of Darkness had already died at the hands of the God of Self and the God of Death in the Dream World, and His fragments had merged into the Godhead of the God of Self, becoming Qin Lang’s first myth-grade equipment.

The God of Light had already been destroyed by the Dragon God. After His death, the curse on Him followed His connection to His creator god and invaded the body of the hostile creator god, causing damage to the hostile creator god—it was because of this strike that the system was able to "smuggle" Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang into this world.

Qin Lang knew very well that this world, and the Gods of Darkness and Light they had met, were just remnants before destruction.

The system hadn't given detailed tasks, only letting them witness the destruction of the world.

Qin Lang had always thought that this task was to let them re-walk the path to godhood, solidify their foundations, turn the power bestowed by the system into their own, and possess the power of true deities.

Witnessing destruction might also be a part of growth—to become a transcendent, such insight was indispensable.

He and Xia Xifeng should have been lurking in this world as bystanders, drifting outside the lives of everyone else.

Qin Lang would not invest emotions in this world.

He believed that Xia Xifeng wasn't stupid, had self-awareness, and would also restrain himself from investing emotions in this world.

But Xia Xifeng seemed to be actively contacting this world, actively building connections with this world, and even actively guiding the God of Light and the God of Darkness to build friendships with him.

chunks.chineseText:
秦琅深吸一口气，捏了捏眉间，咬牙切齿：“夏兮风，不愧是你。”

看来他不能再贪图工具人帮忙刷经验的高效率，该回去了。

……

夏兮风知道秦琅很快就会发现他的意图。

秦琅肯定会生气，然后又会骂他蠢。

如果是以前，夏兮风还会忐忑不安，担忧秦琅又因为他“蠢”而离开。但现在，秦琅已经是他的男朋友，两人绑死了，他无所畏惧！

夏兮风坐在田埂上，趁着休息的空隙写计划书。

光明小兽和黑暗小兽坐在他的左右，手捧夏兮风新开发的炸鸡汉堡，啃得满脸都是碎屑。

黑暗神最初说让光明神给祂带零食。吃了几次零食后，祂一拍脑袋，认为自己犯蠢了。为什么不直接过来呢？反正光明神不像自己那么小气，不会拦着自己。祂连从外神那里学来的投影法术都教给了自己呢。

于是黑暗小兽也常驻夏兮风的农场了。

黑暗神也不再阻拦光明神送快递。两只小兽轮流送快递。

在闲暇的时候，祂们还会帮夏兮风收拾田地。夏兮风发现，祂们帮忙居然也能有经验，便毫不客气地压榨祂们的劳动力。

黑暗神和光明神没有被压榨的自觉，祂们居然对干农活很感兴趣。

神界看来确实太无聊了。

“你要把种植的法术教给其他人吗？”黑暗小兽三两口吃完汉堡，扑进夏兮风怀里让他帮忙擦脸。

夏兮风放下笔记本，制止黑暗小兽拿他衣服擦脸。光明小兽白了黑暗小兽一眼，拿出帕子乖乖擦脸。

“不只是种植。魔法不仅能战斗，还能让生活更方便。”夏兮风道，“神皇只要求你们每隔一百年就要打上一场，没说怎么打，也没规定必须死多少人对吧？”

光明小兽和黑暗小兽/交换了一个心虚的眼神，齐齐点头：“只要是一场能让整个世界的命运都发生震荡的战争就行。”

为了尽可能地减少伤亡，祂们才会想出“勇者战胜魔王”，并亲自下场打一架。

是的，不仅黑暗神会投影当魔王，光明神也会投影下界协助勇者。

夏兮风笑道：“神皇连每一百年的光明和黑暗之战都不细究，那这一百年世界如何发展，祂肯定也不管。”

光明小兽和黑暗小兽再次齐齐点头。

祂们都知道自己的创世神并非只有这一个世界。祂们的世界年轻又稚嫩，位置也很偏僻，神皇很少亲自关心。

夏兮风道：“那我们就可以趁机发展了。”

虽然两位神灵不知道夏兮风为何要说“趁机”，但祂们都对夏兮风所说的魔导技术很感兴趣，愿意全力支持夏兮风。

夏兮风帮黑暗小兽擦干净脸，把祂放到一边，继续写计划书。

龙神向夏兮风支付“信息”时，夏兮风曾询问，创世神就可以随意毁灭自己创造的世界，不受到任何惩罚吗？

当然不是。

创世神创造世界，如父母生出儿女。当生命降临在这个世界上，这生命就只属于他们自己。

创世神可以很容易剥夺祂创造的生命，毁灭祂创造的世界，如父母能很容易地剥夺没有生存能力的年幼儿女的生命，但不代表祂和他们有权力这样做。

创世神毁灭自己的世界也会受到反噬，并且如父母剥夺儿女的性命时一样，儿女越强大，他们的加害就越不容易。

龙神说，创世神不会毁灭已经拥有超脱者的世界。因果太大，即使是创世神也会身受重伤，得不偿失。

夏兮风不知道这个世界什么时候毁灭，但这个时间肯定不足以出现超脱者。甚至这个世界最开始的规则都有漏洞，让它很难诞生超脱者。

敌对创世神在天父的世界隔壁创造这个世界，一开始打的主意就是把它当作武器。敌对创世神不知道什么时候能出现机会，所以这个世界肯定早就埋下了隐患，使其很难诞生超脱者。

但没有超脱者，世界就无力反抗了吗？

这个世界每一个弱小的生灵，他们难道没有资格诅咒毁灭自己的神灵吗？

凡人之身不能逆天，难道在天上捅几个窟窿也不可以吗？

如他所在的信息交汇地那样几乎不可能出现本土超脱者的世界，全文明升级也能对神灵造成伤害，如果这个世界拥有更繁盛的文明，是不是也能对创世神造成更大的反噬？

夏兮风貌似无意地问道：“如果知道世界注定毁灭，我帮助你们让世界毁灭前拥有更多的人口，更高的文明，是不是算杀害了更多的人？”

神界之中，神座之上，黑暗之神和光明之神都为有趣的凡人朋友幼稚的话笑出了声。

“凡人注定死亡，那就不生育新生命了吗？”

“哈哈哈哈小夏你问的什么蠢话？”

夏兮风抬起头，眉眼弯弯：“没错，是蠢话。”

他不知道系统让他来这里干什么。系统也没有发布让他必须做的任务，只是让他来到这个世界，陪着这个世界过完剩余的寿命。

他什么都不需要做。

他也什么都可以做。

“为了我们的友谊，今天吃大餐！我们宰一头小羊羔吃羊肉火锅。”

“好。”

“嗷嗷嗷！”

“酿造的小麦酒应该能喝了，今天咱们不喝牛奶喝小麦酒，不醉不归！”

“可以喝，别醉。”

“就要喝醉，偏要喝醉，嗷嗷嗷！”

夏兮风将笔记本卷起来揣兜里，去宰羊买酒。

为了我们的友谊，为了世上所有的怨愤不平，干杯！

作者有话要说：

虽然更的还是有点晚，但是今天有四千字！
chunks.englishText:
Qin Lang took a deep breath, pinched the bridge of his nose, and gritted his teeth: "Xia Xifeng, you really are something."

It seemed he could no longer be greedy for the high efficiency of having a "tool man" help him grind for experience; it was time to go back.

...

Xia Xifeng knew that Qin Lang would soon discover his intentions.

Qin Lang would surely be angry, and then he would call him an idiot again.

If it were in the past, Xia Xifeng would have been anxious and worried that Qin Lang would leave him because he was "stupid." But now, Qin Lang was already his boyfriend; the two were bound together, and he had nothing to fear!

Xia Xifeng sat on the ridge of the field, writing his project proposal during a break.

The little beast of light and the little beast of darkness sat on his left and right, holding the newly developed fried chicken burgers in their hands, chewing until their faces were covered in crumbs.

The God of Darkness had initially told the God of Light to bring snacks for Him. After eating snacks a few times, He slapped His own head, thinking He had been foolish. Why not just come over directly? After all, the God of Light wasn't as stingy as He was and wouldn't stop Him. He had even taught Him the projection spell He learned from the Outer Gods.

Thus, the little beast of darkness became a permanent resident of Xia Xifeng's farm.

The God of Darkness no longer stopped the God of Light from delivering packages. The two little beasts took turns delivering them.

In their spare time, they would even help Xia Xifeng tidy up the fields. Xia Xifeng discovered that their help actually granted experience points, so he unceremoniously exploited their labor.

The God of Darkness and the God of Light had no self-awareness of being exploited; they were actually quite interested in farm work.

It seemed the Divine Realm was indeed too boring.

"Are you going to teach the farming spells to others?" The little beast of darkness finished the burger in a few bites and pounced into Xia Xifeng's arms, asking him to help wipe his face.

Xia Xifeng put down his notebook and stopped the little beast of darkness from using his clothes to wipe his face. The little beast of light rolled his eyes at the little beast of darkness and took out a handkerchief to wipe his face obediently.

"It's not just farming. Magic isn't just for fighting; it can also make life more convenient," Xia Xifeng said. "The God Emperor only requires you to fight once every hundred years. He didn't say how to fight, nor did He stipulate how many people must die, right?"

The little beast of light and the little beast of darkness exchanged a guilty look and nodded in unison: "As long as it is a war that causes the fate of the entire world to tremble, that is enough."

To minimize casualties as much as possible, they came up with the "Hero defeats the Demon King" scenario and personally descended to have a fight.

Yes, not only would the God of Darkness project a form to act as the Demon King, but the God of Light would also project a form to the lower realm to assist the Hero.

Xia Xifeng laughed: "If the God Emperor doesn't even scrutinize the Light and Darkness War every hundred years, then He certainly won't care how the world develops over these hundred years."

The little beast of light and the little beast of darkness nodded in unison again.

They both knew that their Creator God didn't just have this one world. Their world was young and immature, and its location was remote, so the God Emperor rarely concerned Himself with it personally.

Xia Xifeng said: "Then we can take this opportunity to develop."

Although the two deities didn't know why Xia Xifeng used the phrase "take this opportunity," they were both very interested in the magitech Xia Xifeng spoke of and were willing to support him with all their might.

Xia Xifeng wiped the little beast of darkness's face clean, set him aside, and continued writing his proposal.

When the Dragon God paid Xia Xifeng with "information," Xia Xifeng had once asked: Can a Creator God destroy the world He created at will without suffering any punishment?

Of course not.

A Creator God creates a world like parents giving birth to children. When life descends upon this world, that life belongs only to itself.

A Creator God can easily deprive the life He created and destroy the world He created, just as parents can easily deprive the life of young children who lack the ability to survive, but that does not mean He or they have the right to do so.

A Creator God will also suffer backlash for destroying His own world, and just like when parents deprive their children of their lives, the stronger the children are, the harder it is for them to do harm.

The Dragon God said that a Creator God will not destroy a world that already possesses a Transcendent. The karma is too great; even a Creator God would be severely injured, making the cost outweigh the gains.

Xia Xifeng didn't know when this world would be destroyed, but there was certainly not enough time for a Transcendent to appear. Even the initial rules of this world had loopholes, making it very difficult for a Transcendent to be born.

The hostile Creator God created this world next to the Father God's world, intending from the start to use it as a weapon. The hostile Creator God didn't know when an opportunity would arise, so this world must have been planted with hidden dangers long ago to prevent the birth of a Transcendent.

But without a Transcendent, is the world powerless to resist?

Does every weak creature in this world not have the qualification to curse the god who destroys them?

If a mortal body cannot defy the heavens, is it not possible to poke a few holes in the sky?

Just like the world where he came from—an information hub where it was almost impossible for a local Transcendent to appear—couldn't a full civilization upgrade also cause damage to the gods? If this world possessed a more prosperous civilization, could it also cause a greater backlash to the Creator God?

Xia Xifeng asked seemingly casually: "If I know the world is destined to be destroyed, and I help you increase the population and raise the civilization level before the world is destroyed, does that count as killing more people?"

In the Divine Realm, upon their thrones, the God of Darkness and the God of Light both laughed at the naive words of their interesting mortal friend.

"Mortals are destined to die, so should they stop giving birth to new life?"

"Hahahaha, Little Xia, what kind of stupid question is that?"

Xia Xifeng looked up, his eyes curving: "That's right, it's a stupid question."

He didn't know why the system had brought him here. The system hadn't issued any mandatory tasks; it just brought him to this world to accompany it through the remainder of its lifespan.

He didn't need to do anything.

And he could do anything.

"For the sake of our friendship, let's have a feast today! We'll slaughter a lamb and have a mutton hotpot."

"Good."

"Awoo!"

"The wheat ale I brewed should be ready to drink. Today we won't drink milk, we'll drink wheat ale. We won't stop until we're drunk!"

"We can drink, but don't get drunk."

"I want to get drunk, I insist on getting drunk, awoo!"

Xia Xifeng rolled up his notebook, tucked it into his pocket, and went to slaughter the lamb and buy the ale.

To our friendship, and to all the grievances and injustices in the world—cheers!

chunks.chineseText:
第123章 一更

夏兮风的系统仍旧是手把手带着他干活，每次干活，系统老师都在他脑海里碎碎念一大堆知识。

梦世界的创造规则与这个世界的创造规则融合成了他手中这个简易的系统，能不能学会系统老师教导的知识，全靠他自己。

如秦琅能很快提升战斗实力一样，夏兮风总是能很快学会“完美制作”。

改良土壤、培育良种、施肥灌溉……田间地野的所有知识，都能融入魔导科技。

这个世界的神灵划分很简陋，大部分神灵都是光明或者黑暗的属神，光明和黑暗拥有这个世界最完整的神灵权限，祂们是这个世界最有可能超脱的先天神灵。

然而在《奇域幻想》中，这两个神灵死得轻描淡写，一个成为陪衬龙神战斗力的背景板，一个剧情查无此神只出现在玩家的推测中。

在《奇域幻想》中声名大噪，成为末世主力的外神，在此时都是没什么信徒和存在感的属神。

因此，夏兮风要使用的魔导技术，黑暗和光明的神灵都能找出完整的团队配合他推广。

等级提升后，夏兮风只把他和秦琅的小木屋提升成不会受潮的小石屋，剩余的石材全部用于搭建一座他梦想中的学园。

他模仿了曾经去蹭过课的帝都学院，想为这个童话般的奇幻世界搭建一个科技进步的平台，就像是中世纪走向新时代那样。

一块块石板从夏兮风手中覆盖荒野，拼凑出魔导学园的雏形。

他行走在平坦的石板路上，藏书的高塔、授课的殿堂和一定会有学生入住的宿舍，如雨后春笋般一一拔地而起。

灰色的石头建筑古朴简陋，明明是新造的学园却像是从久远的时光里突然现身的遗迹。

夏兮风偏着头对光明神和黑暗神的投影道：“这里将种满绿树和鲜花。藤蔓会爬上灰色的屋顶，到了开花的时节，它们将变成最漂亮的窗帘从屋檐垂落。”

光明神和黑暗神的投影仰望灰扑扑的石头屋子，重重点头。

光明神：“我将降下神谕，所有人都有资格参加入学考试。”

夏兮风泼冷水：“先别宣布，你先制定招生计划，分设招生点啊！我们这里装不下全世界的人。”

心里酸溜溜的黑暗神投影哈哈大笑，在空中不断翻滚。

光明神的投影小兽垂下了头，很是羞赧。

黑暗小兽大声道：“我也要，我也要！在魔界也建造一座学园！”

夏兮风笑眯眯道：“等我解锁传送图腾，我就去魔界建造学园。”

黑暗小兽飞在半空中，扯着夏兮风的袖子使劲摇晃：“还有多久？”

夏兮风道：“等秦琅回来，我升级就快了。”

在梦世界，他和秦琅隔着老远都能共享经验。在这个世界，系统共享经验有距离限制，必须处于同一张地图。他的等级不够，地图都还没解锁呢。

种地游戏要解锁自动化之后升级才快，手动肝的经验实在是太少了。前期还是得靠秦琅刷怪。

黑暗小兽和光明小兽对视了一眼，默契地保守了秦琅很快就会到来的秘密。

黑暗神让教会给了秦琅最快的骷髅马，光明神让教会带着最快的金角马在教皇国边界接应，秦琅明天就能到达了。

祂们要吓夏兮风一跳。

埃德尔男爵和约翰神父正在与夏兮风商量运送更多的石材来建造学园，不用夏兮风一个一个石头的敲时，埃德尔男爵突然警觉地看向天边。

约翰神父已经拿出了魔杖，慈祥的面容变得充满杀气，就像夏兮风前世看到的庙宇里的怒目金刚。

危险的气息笼罩了两人。身经百战的两人立刻把夏兮风护在身后，警惕地看着天际的黑点。

夏兮风愣了一下，眼睛睁大。

他仰着头，双手合在嘴边，朝着天空大喊：“秦琅！我在这里！”

埃德尔男爵和约翰神父惊讶回头，看向夏兮风。

夏兮风脸上绽放大大的笑脸，喊完后就高举着双手挥舞。

埃德尔男爵和约翰神父对视。

他们的感知不会错。来的人身上充满了血腥和怨气，还有隐藏得极好的魔界气息。虽然他们知道夏兮风的同伴流落到了魔界，光明神特意降下神谕让教会迎接，但这个人的气息怎么都不像好人，而是从尸山血海里走出来的魔族。

他怎么可能是光明神的恩赐者，夏兮风的同伴？

两人还在对视，夏兮风已经越过两人，朝着天际黑点的方向奔跑。

埃德尔男爵和约翰神父看见了天空那人骑着的是光明教会中也很稀有的金角马。

那个危险的人，居然真的是夏兮风的同伴？

秦琅远远看见夏兮风跑来，快得像一阵风。

他很困惑。不是说简陋版系统技能面板只能创造物品，没有其他生活技能吗？

“降落。”秦琅轻拍了一下马背。金角马朝着地面俯冲。

它还未落到地面，秦琅就从它身上翻下，几个瞬身就落在了地上，比号称最快坐骑之一的金角马还快。

在秦琅落地的时候，夏兮风好像能预判似的，猛地跳起扑上前。

秦琅张开双臂，正好接住飞扑的夏兮风。

“昨天不是说还在魔界刷怪吗？”夏兮风紧紧抱住秦琅的脖子。

秦琅的回答一如既往地惹人生气：“骗你的。”

夏兮风很想板着脸假装生气，但笑容怎么也压不住。

他只好把脸埋在秦琅肩膀上，恶狠狠道：“混蛋！”

秦琅在夏兮风耳边发出一声轻笑。

夏兮风终于调整好神情，抬起脸转头自认为很凶地瞪了秦琅一眼。

秦琅搂住夏兮风腰间的手上移，扣住夏兮风的后脑勺，吻了上去。

夏兮风眼睑抖了抖，微微张开嘴，容纳了秦琅的舌尖，挂在秦琅脖子上的双臂收拢。

不远处，一黑一白两只小兽在空中急刹车。

更远处，埃德尔男爵和约翰神父双双瞠目结舌。

啊，不是，你们没看见旁边还有其他人吗？不尴尬吗？

【战友绑定，战友系统激活。】

【检测到宿主双方均拥有空间背包。系统背包激活，目前为30格。存入手镯的物品自动进入系统背包，战友背包互通，物资共享。】

【装备面板共享激活。】

【技能面板共享激活。】

【地图共享激活。】

【经验共享激活。】……

系统跳出一连串提示，打断了暧昧的气氛。

夏兮风推开不受系统提示影响，还想继续亲下去的秦琅，兴奋地查看系统的更新。

他正想说什么，被秦琅长臂一捞，抱在了怀里。

夏兮风：“啊？等等，先研究技能！嘶！咬到舌头了！”

秦琅已经升到了能打开地图的等级。他瞟了一眼地图，如他和夏兮风刚穿越到梦世界时一样，抱着夏兮风几个瞬步便“飘”了老远。

黑色小兽和白色小兽转身。

埃德尔男爵和约翰神父转头。

他们眼睁睁地看着秦琅抱着夏兮风“飘”到了小石屋前，开门，关门。

呃……

不是，你真的这么目中无人的吗？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 123: First Update

Xia Xifeng's system still guided him step-by-step in his work. Every time he worked, the System Teacher would chatter away in his mind, imparting a vast amount of knowledge.

The creation rules of the Dream World had merged with the creation rules of this world to form the simple system in his hands. Whether he could learn the knowledge taught by the System Teacher depended entirely on himself.

Just as Qin Lang could quickly improve his combat strength, Xia Xifeng was always able to quickly master "Perfect Crafting."

Improving soil, cultivating high-quality seeds, fertilizing, and irrigating... all the knowledge of the fields and wilderness could be integrated into magitech.

The classification of gods in this world was very crude; most gods were subordinate deities of Light or Darkness. Light and Darkness possessed the most complete divine authority in this world, and they were the innate gods most likely to transcend.

However, in "Fantasy of the Strange Realm," these two gods died in a trivial manner—one became a background prop for the Dragon God's combat power, and the other was a character who didn't even exist in the plot, appearing only in players' speculations.

The Outer Gods, who became famous in "Fantasy of the Strange Realm" and became the main force of the apocalypse, were merely subordinate deities with few believers and little presence at this time.

Therefore, for the magitech Xia Xifeng wanted to use, the gods of Darkness and Light could find complete teams to cooperate with him in promoting it.

After his level increased, Xia Xifeng only upgraded his and Qin Lang's small wooden cabin into a small stone house that wouldn't get damp. He used all the remaining stone materials to build an academy of his dreams.

He modeled it after the Imperial Academy where he had once snuck into classes, wanting to build a platform for technological progress for this fairy-tale-like fantasy world, much like the transition from the Middle Ages to a new era.

Stone slab after stone slab covered the wilderness from Xia Xifeng's hands, piecing together the prototype of the Magitech Academy.

He walked on the flat stone paths, and the towers for storing books, the halls for teaching, and the dormitories that would surely house students rose one after another like bamboo shoots after a spring rain.

The gray stone buildings were simple and primitive; despite being newly built, the academy looked like ruins that had suddenly appeared from the distant past.

Xia Xifeng tilted his head and said to the projections of the God of Light and the God of Darkness: "This place will be planted with green trees and flowers. Vines will climb up the gray roofs, and when the blooming season arrives, they will turn into the most beautiful curtains hanging from the eaves."

The projections of the God of Light and the God of Darkness looked up at the gray stone houses and nodded heavily.

God of Light: "I will issue a divine decree; everyone is qualified to take the entrance exam."

Xia Xifeng poured cold water on the idea: "Don't announce it yet. You need to formulate an enrollment plan and set up enrollment points first! We can't fit everyone in the world here."

The sour-hearted projection of the God of Darkness laughed loudly, rolling in the air.

The little beast projection of the God of Light lowered his head, looking very shy.

The little beast of darkness said loudly: "I want one too, I want one too! Build an academy in the Demon Realm as well!"

Xia Xifeng said with a smile: "Once I unlock the teleportation totem, I'll go to the Demon Realm to build an academy."

The little beast of darkness flew in mid-air, tugging at Xia Xifeng's sleeve and shaking it vigorously: "How much longer?"

Xia Xifeng said: "Once Qin Lang comes back, my leveling will be fast."

In the Dream World, he and Qin Lang could share experience even when they were far apart. In this world, the system's experience sharing had a distance limit; they had to be on the same map. His level wasn't high enough, and he hadn't even unlocked the maps yet.

In a farming game, leveling up is only fast after unlocking automation; the experience from manual grinding is simply too little. In the early stages, he still had to rely on Qin Lang to grind monsters.

The little beast of darkness and the little beast of light exchanged a glance, tacitly keeping the secret that Qin Lang would arrive soon.

The God of Darkness had the church give Qin Lang the fastest skeleton horse, and the God of Light had the church meet him at the border of the Papal State with the fastest golden-horned horse. Qin Lang would arrive tomorrow.

They wanted to give Xia Xifeng a surprise.

Baron Edel and Father John were discussing with Xia Xifeng about transporting more stone materials to build the academy. Just as Xia Xifeng was about to stop tapping stones one by one, Baron Edel suddenly looked toward the horizon with alertness.

Father John had already taken out his magic wand, his kind face becoming full of murderous intent, just like the angry Vajra in the temples Xia Xifeng had seen in his past life.

An aura of danger enveloped the two. The two battle-hardened men immediately shielded Xia Xifeng behind them, watching the black dot on the horizon vigilantly.

Xia Xifeng froze for a moment, his eyes widening.

He looked up, cupped his hands around his mouth, and shouted at the sky: "Qin Lang! I'm here!"

Baron Edel and Father John turned back in surprise, looking at Xia Xifeng.

A big smile bloomed on Xia Xifeng's face, and after shouting, he waved his hands high in the air.

Baron Edel and Father John looked at each other.

Their perception couldn't be wrong. The person coming was filled with blood and resentment, as well as a well-hidden aura of the Demon Realm. Although they knew Xia Xifeng's companion had been stranded in the Demon Realm and the God of Light had specifically issued a decree for the church to welcome him, this person's aura didn't look like a good person's at all; he looked like a demon who had walked out of a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood.

How could he possibly be the blessed one of the God of Light, Xia Xifeng's companion?

The two were still looking at each other when Xia Xifeng had already bypassed them and was running toward the direction of the black dot in the sky.

Baron Edel and Father John saw that the person in the sky was riding a golden-horned horse, which was rare even in the Church of Light.

That dangerous person was actually Xia Xifeng's companion?

Qin Lang saw Xia Xifeng running toward him from afar, as fast as a gust of wind.

He was very puzzled. Wasn't it said that the simple system skill panel could only create items and had no other life skills?

"Land." Qin Lang patted the horse's back lightly. The golden-horned horse dove toward the ground.

Before it even landed, Qin Lang flipped off its back, landing on the ground in a few flashes, faster than the golden-horned horse, which was known as one of the fastest mounts.

As Qin Lang landed, Xia Xifeng seemed to anticipate it, jumping up and pouncing forward.

Qin Lang opened his arms and caught the pouncing Xia Xifeng perfectly.

"Didn't you say yesterday that you were still grinding monsters in the Demon Realm?" Xia Xifeng hugged Qin Lang's neck tightly.

Qin Lang's answer was as annoying as ever: "I lied to you."

Xia Xifeng really wanted to keep a straight face and pretend to be angry, but he couldn't suppress his smile.

He had no choice but to bury his face in Qin Lang's shoulder and say fiercely: "Asshole!"

Qin Lang let out a low chuckle in Xia Xifeng's ear.

Xia Xifeng finally adjusted his expression, lifted his face, turned his head, and glared at Qin Lang in what he thought was a very fierce manner.

Qin Lang's hand, which was around Xia Xifeng's waist, moved up to hold the back of Xia Xifeng's head and kissed him.

Xia Xifeng's eyelids fluttered, and he opened his mouth slightly, accommodating the tip of Qin Lang's tongue, his arms tightening around Qin Lang's neck.

Not far away, the black and white little beasts slammed on the brakes in mid-air.

Further away, Baron Edel and Father John were both dumbfounded.

Uh, no, didn't you see there are other people here? Isn't it awkward?

[Comrade binding, comrade system activated.]

[Detected that both host parties possess spatial backpacks. System backpack activated, currently 30 slots. Items stored in bracelets automatically enter the system backpack, comrade backpacks are interconnected, and supplies are shared.]

[Equipment panel sharing activated.]

[Skill panel sharing activated.]

[Map sharing activated.]

[Experience sharing activated.]...

The system popped up a series of prompts, interrupting the ambiguous atmosphere.

Xia Xifeng pushed away Qin Lang, who was unaffected by the system prompts and wanted to continue kissing. He excitedly checked the system updates.

Just as he was about to say something, he was scooped up by Qin Lang's long arm and held in his embrace.

Xia Xifeng: "Ah? Wait, let's study the skills first! Hiss! I bit my tongue!"

Qin Lang had already leveled up to the point where he could open the map. He glanced at the map, and just like when he and Xia Xifeng first traveled to the Dream World, he held Xia Xifeng and "floated" far away in a few flashes.

The black little beast and the white little beast turned around.

Baron Edel and Father John turned their heads.

They watched helplessly as Qin Lang carried Xia Xifeng and "floated" to the small stone house, opened the door, and closed it.

Uh...

No, are you really that oblivious to others?

chunks.chineseText:
埃德尔男爵抬起胳膊肘撞了一下约翰神父：“你猜，他们关上门会做什么？”

约翰神父：“……叙旧？”

埃德尔男爵给了约翰神父“你开玩笑吗”的眼神。

黑色小兽脸上浮现恶作剧的笑容，悄悄往小石屋飞。

白色小兽抓住了黑色小兽的尾巴。

“不要捣乱。”

“就要。”

黑色小兽使劲往前飞，白色小兽抓着祂的尾巴使劲往后飞，势均力敌，僵持不下。

外面如何，都被秦琅关在了门外。

秦琅关门的时候，夏兮风终于挣扎落地。

“系统……唔！”

夏兮风刚说两个字，就被秦琅抵在了门上，又被封住了嘴。

可恶，系统私聊功能还没开，被封住嘴就没办法说话！

夏兮风生气了，轻咬了一下秦琅的舌尖。

让、我、说、话！

秦琅的唇舌与夏兮风分离，深吸了一口气，埋头吻住了夏兮风的颈侧，手掌从夏兮风的背部滑入夏兮风的腰间。

夏兮风瞬间炸毛，抬起脚踹秦琅：“喂！你还想在这里做啊？床又不远！”

秦琅挡住夏兮风的腿，握着夏兮风的小腿一拉，两人一同摔在了厚厚的地毯上。

夏兮风仰面落地的时候，后背被秦琅的手掌护住。

他双手按在秦琅肩膀上，正想把覆在身上的秦琅推开，腰间就是一凉，然后是滚烫的热源贴了上来，令他一个哆嗦。

夏兮风按在秦琅肩膀上的手指紧了紧，无奈道：“急什么，我又不会跑。”

他捧起秦琅的脸，啪嗒亲了一口：“哪次我们分别，我不是很快主动来找你？要没有安全感，也是我没有安全感吧？”

秦琅眼眸一颤。他没想到夏兮风会这么说。

他记起曾经两人神魂交融的时候，夏兮风的记忆和感情。

秦琅以为夏兮风知道自己为何回避时，已经不再对此耿耿于怀。

既然他们已经交缠在一起，自己就再不会放手。夏兮风应该很清楚这一点，毕竟没有人比夏兮风更了解自己。

夏兮风看着秦琅惊愕的神情，眼中闪过一丝懊恼。

他将脸撇向一旁，拉上裤子，把秦琅推开，从地上爬起来：“我们还是先研究系统更新吧。”

秦琅站起来，拉住夏兮风的手臂，往自己怀里一带，将夏兮风拦腰抱起，扛在肩头。

“喂！”正在懊恼的夏兮风吓了一跳。

这次秦琅多走了几步路，把夏兮风丢在了床上。

夏兮风：“你听不懂人话吗？！”

秦琅把想要从床上爬起来的夏兮风按回去，将夏兮风禁锢在双臂之间：“嗯。”

夏兮风炸毛。你这个“嗯”是什么意思？！

秦琅：“不会了。”

夏兮风：“什么？”

秦琅俯身：“我之前已经说过，不会再在原地等你来找我。这次就是我来找你。”

夏兮风：“……”

他不自在地撇过脸：“哦。”

秦琅的吻落在了他的脸侧。

作者有话要说：

[狗头]
chunks.englishText:
Baron Edel nudged Father John with his elbow: "Guess what they'll do when they close the door?"

Father John: "...Catch up on old times?"

Baron Edel gave Father John a "Are you kidding me" look.

A mischievous smile appeared on the black little beast's face, and he flew toward the small stone house quietly.

The white little beast grabbed the black little beast's tail.

"Don't make trouble."

"I want to."

The black little beast flew forward with all his might, while the white little beast grabbed his tail and flew backward with all his might. They were evenly matched and at a stalemate.

Whatever was happening outside was locked out by Qin Lang.

When Qin Lang closed the door, Xia Xifeng finally struggled to land on his feet.

"System... mph!"

Xia Xifeng had only said two words before he was pressed against the door by Qin Lang and his mouth was sealed again.

Damn it, the system private chat function hadn't been opened yet; he couldn't speak if his mouth was sealed!

Xia Xifeng was angry and bit the tip of Qin Lang's tongue lightly.

Let. Me. Speak!

Qin Lang's lips and tongue separated from Xia Xifeng's. He took a deep breath, buried his head to kiss the side of Xia Xifeng's neck, and his palm slid from Xia Xifeng's back into his waist.

Xia Xifeng instantly bristled and kicked Qin Lang: "Hey! Do you still want to do it here? The bed isn't far!"

Qin Lang blocked Xia Xifeng's leg, grabbed his calf, and pulled, and the two of them fell onto the thick carpet together.

When Xia Xifeng landed on his back, his back was protected by Qin Lang's palm.

He pressed his hands on Qin Lang's shoulders, just about to push Qin Lang off, when he felt a chill at his waist, followed by a scorching heat source pressing against him, making him shiver.

Xia Xifeng's fingers, pressed against Qin Lang's shoulders, tightened, and he said helplessly: "What's the rush? I'm not going to run away."

He cupped Qin Lang's face and gave him a peck: "Every time we parted, didn't I come to find you proactively soon after? If anyone is insecure, it should be me, right?"

Qin Lang's eyes trembled. He hadn't expected Xia Xifeng to say that.

He remembered the memories and emotions of Xia Xifeng when their souls had merged in the past.

Qin Lang thought that since Xia Xifeng knew why he had been avoiding him, he would no longer hold it against him.

Since they were already intertwined, he would never let go again. Xia Xifeng should be very clear about this; after all, no one knew him better than Xia Xifeng.

Xia Xifeng looked at Qin Lang's stunned expression, a flash of annoyance crossing his eyes.

He turned his face away, pulled up his pants, pushed Qin Lang away, and climbed up from the floor: "Let's study the system update first."

Qin Lang stood up, grabbed Xia Xifeng's arm, pulled him into his embrace, and scooped him up over his shoulder.

"Hey!" Xia Xifeng, who was still feeling annoyed, was startled.

This time, Qin Lang took a few more steps and dumped Xia Xifeng onto the bed.

Xia Xifeng: "Can't you understand human speech?!"

Qin Lang pressed Xia Xifeng, who was trying to climb off the bed, back down and imprisoned him between his arms: "Yeah."

Xia Xifeng bristled. What is the meaning of that "Yeah"?!

Qin Lang: "It won't happen again."

Xia Xifeng: "What?"

Qin Lang leaned down: "I said before that I wouldn't wait for you to come find me in the same place again. This time, I came to find you."

Xia Xifeng: "..."

He turned his face away uncomfortably: "Oh."

Qin Lang's kiss landed on the side of his face.

第124章 一更

夏兮风睁开眼睛的时候，背靠着秦琅，被秦琅抱在怀里，浑身酸疼。

他唏嘘了一下，好久没有感受到腰酸背疼了。这个新身体不行啊。

他动了一下，背后拥抱着他的人也动了一下，身体内某部位传来难以描述的拉扯感，让他脸色一黑。

夏兮风扭头看着下巴搁在他肩膀上的秦琅：“洗了澡你怎么又进去了？”

他记得被秦琅抱去洗澡的时候，明明已经分开了！

秦琅懒洋洋道：“温暖。”

夏兮风：“……”信不信我睡相不好给拧了！

夏兮风想从秦琅怀里离开，被秦琅死死禁锢在怀里，扭来扭去体内感觉更明显，赶紧停下。

可惜已经晚了，身体酸疼加重。

在秦琅还想再来一次时，被夏兮风双手推脸：“等回去随便你做多久，现在我撑不住了！”

秦琅将脸埋在夏兮风的颈间，遮住眼底的不满足。

最初他和夏兮风神魂相交实属意外，以为再不愿陷入没有隐私的尴尬境地。

不知道从什么时候开始，两人习惯性在欢好的时候神魂交缠。虽然他们可以不去看对方的记忆，但只要想看，就可以随时翻阅。对方的一切都向自己敞开。

已经习惯神魂交缠，只是简单的肌肤亲昵，已经不能满足秦琅。即使夏兮风把日记本交给他，他还是不满足。

越是肌肤相亲，越只是身体的欢愉，他就越不满足，恨不得将夏兮风揉进身体里。

如果是在梦世界，他确实可以将夏兮风完全揉进身体里，从神魂到血肉完全交缠，没有一丝缝隙。

没见到的时候还能忍受，等见面时他才发现，自己的忍耐力并没有想象得那么好。

秦琅不由想，在原本的世界中，他以为一切都在掌握中，自己的理智足够压制偏执。

他真的能压制吗？真的能容忍夏兮风离开，容忍夏兮风将特殊对待转移到其他人身上吗？

怀抱着夏兮风，秦琅不确定了。

或许他只是自以为是，自欺欺人罢了。从生出危机感，试图推开夏兮风开始，他可能就已经没有救了。

“只要一直在一起，我什么事你不知道？不用翻看神魂里的记忆你也知道。”夏兮风扒拉着颈间的毛绒绒大脑袋，嘴角压不住上弯。

秦琅平时装高冷，撒娇起来特别可爱。

不能笑不能笑，笑了他恼羞成怒，就不会无意间撒娇了。秦琅就是太爱面子，太喜欢端着。

秦琅轻咬了一下夏兮风的耳垂。

无论他想什么，夏兮风总是能一眼看穿，让他怀疑他和夏兮风的智商差距是不是假的。

“这下可以看系统更新了吧？”夏兮风催促。系统更新后他一直没看，心痒痒的，十分不舒服。

“唉……”秦琅轻叹了一口气，对夏兮风总是破坏气氛而略有不满，“不累了？”

夏兮风道：“累也要看，不看睡不着。”

秦琅意有所指：“我可以让你很快睡着。”

夏兮风扯了扯秦琅的头发：“不做了！说不做就不做！”

秦琅遗憾地松开夏兮风，和夏兮风并肩平躺在床上，一起研究系统更新。

系统原本的“战友”功能解锁了一部分。他们能共享背包、地图、经验、装备，技能也有了更新。

秦琅的系统更新很简单，只是增加了战斗力而已，不须多提。

夏兮风多了“自创”菜单。他可以运用这个世界的材料，自己研究出东西。自创的东西得到系统认可之后，可以“献祭”给系统，解锁更多技能，增加系统背包格数。

解锁的技能中除了夏兮风被锁定的例如“跑得更快”“百毒不侵”“无掉落伤害”等生存技能外，还能解锁学院面板。

学院面板是如同希望之城面板一样的经营板块，如同常见的模拟经营游戏一样。夏兮风可以在学院面板里管理他即将建造的新学院，根据学生面板适时调整课程。

学院面板中有一项重要指标为“世界影响力”。

这次系统终于出了“主线任务”。

本来他们需要待到世界毁灭才能返回，现在只要“世界影响力”进度条满了就能回去。

简单来说，系统与在梦世界一样，仍旧是以夏兮风为主做任务，秦琅负责辅助和当保镖。

夏兮风没多想，秦琅在学院板块上点了一下：“系统猜不到你的想法，而是以你的举动来制定任务。这个主线任务可能另有原因。”

夏兮风：“嗯。”

秦琅：“？”

夏兮风：“？”

秦琅：“然后？”

夏兮风：“不是该你说然后吗？”

秦琅深呼吸了一下，道：“我是让你思考。”

夏兮风用肩头撞了撞秦琅的肩头：“懒得思考。你都思考出答案了，我还思考什么。你聪明的脑袋瓜子能不能用一用？别老是无脑战斗爽。”

秦琅气乐了。你不思考，还是我的问题了？他只是不喜欢走剧情和与陌生人打交道，什么时候没思考了？希望之城那么大一摊子事，难道不是自己在管理？夏兮风就只负责研究生产！

虽然之后什么都丢给戴蒙了。

秦琅心虚了一秒。

看见秦琅突如其来的心虚表情，夏兮风秒懂，也跟着心虚了一秒。

啊，戴蒙，不愧是玩家在新手村最好的兄弟，所有玩家的白月光朱砂痣，竖起大拇指！

两人交换了一个心虚的眼神，继续研究系统。

夏兮风懒得思考，秦琅就直接说了。

他猜测，夏兮风建立学院，推广魔导科技，引领世界文明发展，对这个世界的创世神可能真的有影响。

当世界影响力进度条满的时候，就是敌对创世神察觉到他们，系统必须把他们接走的时候。否则系统完全可以让他们多搞事几年，引发更大的浪潮。

夏兮风将“儿女强大了，父母就不能轻易左右儿女性命”的想法告诉了秦琅。秦琅认可夏兮风的想法。

任务的更新，或许是系统对他们想法的回应。

“我们的目标就是在世界毁灭前肝满进度条！”夏兮风懂了，“世界什么时候毁灭，你有头绪吗？”

秦琅：“创世神不能直接攻击自己的世界。祂肯定在这个世界的底层逻辑上埋下了隐患，可以随时引爆。在有神的世界，所有规则，包括用于引爆世界的规则，都一定会成为神灵。”

秦琅问黑暗教会要神学书籍，不只是寻找夏兮风可能会降落的神域。

他听到龙神对世界危机的解密后，心里就有了这个猜测。

那位象征着世界毁灭的外神肯定会来到梦世界。只要知道那位外神的原型和诞生的时间，就可以推测出世界毁灭的时间。

秦琅：“象征世界毁灭的外神，到了梦世界也可能是毁灭梦世界本土规则的重要武器。我们或许能在这个世界找到破解的方法。”

夏兮风夸赞：“你脑子动起来就是好使，但你怎么就是不动呢？”

秦琅：“？”好端端地聊天，你非得损我吗？

秦琅本来想对夏兮风温柔点，但夏兮风根本不给他机会。

夏兮风多了“自创”菜单。他可以运用这个世界的材料，自己研究出东西。自创的东西得到系统认可之后，可以“献祭”给系统，解锁更多技能，增加系统背包格数。

解锁的技能中除了夏兮风被锁定的例如“跑得更快”“百毒不侵”“无掉落伤害”等生存技能外，还能解锁学院面板。

学院面板是如同希望之城面板一样的经营板块，如同常见的模拟经营游戏一样。夏兮风可以在学院面板里管理他即将建造的新学院，根据学生面板适时调整课程。

学院面板中有一项重要指标为“世界影响力”。

这次系统终于出了“主线任务”。

本来他们需要待到世界毁灭才能返回，现在只要“世界影响力”进度条满了就能回去。

简单来说，系统与在梦世界一样，仍旧是以夏兮风为主做任务，秦琅负责辅助和当保镖。

夏兮风没多想，秦琅在学院板块上点了一下：“系统猜不到你的想法，而是以你的举动来制定任务。这个主线任务可能另有原因。”

夏兮风：“嗯。”

秦琅：“？”

夏兮风：“？”

秦琅：“然后？”

夏兮风：“不是该你说然后吗？”

秦琅深呼吸了一下，道：“我是让你思考。”

夏兮风用肩头撞了撞秦琅的肩头：“懒得思考。你都思考出答案了，我还思考什么。你聪明的脑袋瓜子能不能用一用？别老是无脑战斗爽。”

秦琅气乐了。你不思考，还是我的问题了？他只是不喜欢走剧情和与陌生人打交道，什么时候没思考了？希望之城那么大一摊子事，难道不是自己在管理？夏兮风就只负责研究生产！

虽然之后什么都丢给戴蒙了。

秦琅心虚了一秒。

看见秦琅突如其来的心虚表情，夏兮风秒懂，也跟着心虚了一秒。

啊，戴蒙，不愧是玩家在新手村最好的兄弟，所有玩家的白月光朱砂痣，竖起大拇指！

两人交换了一个心虚的眼神，继续研究系统。

夏兮风懒得思考，秦琅就直接说了。

他猜测，夏兮风建立学院，推广魔导科技，引领世界文明发展，对这个世界的创世神可能真的有影响。

当世界影响力进度条满的时候，就是敌对创世神察觉到他们，系统必须把他们接走的时候。否则系统完全可以让他们多搞事几年，引发更大的浪潮。

夏兮风将“儿女强大了，父母就不能轻易左右儿女性命”的想法告诉了秦琅。秦琅认可夏兮风的想法。

任务的更新，或许是系统对他们想法的回应。

“我们的目标就是在世界毁灭前肝满进度条！”夏兮风懂了，“世界什么时候毁灭，你有头绪吗？”

秦琅：“创世神不能直接攻击自己的世界。祂肯定在这个世界的底层逻辑上埋下了隐患，可以随时引爆。在有神的世界，所有规则，包括用于引爆世界的规则，都一定会成为神灵。”

秦琅问黑暗教会要神学书籍，不只是寻找夏兮风可能会降落的神域。

他听到龙神对世界危机的解密后，心里就有了这个猜测。

那位象征着世界毁灭的外神肯定会来到梦世界。只要知道那位外神的原型和诞生的时间，就可以推测出世界毁灭的时间。

秦琅：“象征世界毁灭的外神，到了梦世界也可能是毁灭梦世界本土规则的重要武器。我们或许能在这个世界找到破解的方法。”

夏兮风夸赞：“你脑子动起来就是好使，但你怎么就是不动呢？”

秦琅：“？”好端端地聊天，你非得损我吗？

秦琅本来想对夏兮风温柔点，但夏兮风根本不给他机会。

chunks.chineseText:
秦琅：“哦，我不动脑子不是因为你吗？我怕和你生殖隔离。”

夏兮风没反应过来：“啊？”

秦琅翻身，趁着夏兮风没反应过来，背对着夏兮风睡觉。

夏兮风以为秦琅累了。他正好也累了，便闭上眼。

等他快睡着的时候，猛地睁开眼，狠踹了枕边人一脚：“你骂我笨的和你不是一个物种？！”

“噗……”秦琅故意没忍住笑。

夏兮风气得拧他。

秦琅继续笑：“现在才反应过来，你说你是不是智商低？”

夏兮风把背对着自己的秦琅扒拉过来，狠狠扯秦琅的脸。

屋外，约翰神父和埃德尔男爵已经离开。

原本和夏兮风一起住屋里的光明小兽和黑暗小兽坐在门前，面面相觑。

黑暗小兽：“我们总不能在屋外睡觉吧？”

光明小兽：“唉……”

黑暗小兽：“太过分了！夏兮风是不是完全忘记我们了！”

光明小兽：“嗯。”

黑暗小兽：“别拦着我，我要去砸窗户！”

光明小兽抱住黑暗小兽的尾巴不撒手。

黑暗小兽：“啊啊啊啊气死我了！”

光明小兽：“唉。”

屋内，因为腰酸背疼不敌秦琅，无奈停战继续睡觉的夏兮风在睡着前，又猛地惊醒。

夏兮风：“唉，秦琅，我好像忘记了什么。”

秦琅：“睡觉，明天想。”

夏兮风：“也对，既然想不起来，应该不是什么重要的事。”

他往秦琅肩膀上一靠，安心地睡了。

半夜，外面下起淅淅沥沥的小雨，是最好的催眠白噪音。

呼……呼……呼……

“哐！”

“哗啦！”

夏兮风和秦琅同时被巨大的噪声惊醒。

秦琅一秒换装，从床上翻身跃下。

夏兮风也赶紧换装跟上。

两人到了客厅，看见一只双眼在黑夜中闪烁着诡异光芒的小兽，举着一个巨大的锤子，从屋外使劲砸窗户。

窗户玻璃已经被砸碎。

夏兮风打开屋内魔法灯，黑暗小兽还在砸窗户，光明小兽飞在他身后撑着伞，表情特别可怜。

光明小兽：“下雨了，我想回家睡觉。”

夏兮风：“……”

他想起自己忘记了什么。平时光明小兽和黑暗小兽都在屋里睡觉，他没有在屋外给祂们搭窝！

秦琅看向夏兮风：“你和他们一起睡？”

夏兮风：“啊……嗯……不，等等，你连这个醋都要吃吗？祂们只是毛绒绒！”

黑暗小兽和光明小兽从窗户大洞里钻进来，不管气氛突然紧张的两人，去寻自己的窝睡觉了。

夏兮风是睡不着了。

再腰酸背痛也睡不着了。

他得修窗户，还得安抚某个莫名其妙吃醋的家伙。

那只是毛绒绒而已！

作者有话要说：

一般的醋是不吃的，但那是投影，不是普通毛绒绒。

> "In the dead of night, the pitter-patter of a light rain outside makes for the perfect hypnotic white noise."

**Casual and concise:**

**Key nuance:**
*   **"淅淅沥沥"** is a classic onomatopoeia for light, steady rain. "Pitter-patter" is the most evocative English equivalent.
*   **"催眠"** can be translated as "hypnotic," "lullaby," or simply "to drift off to," depending on how much you want to emphasize the sleep-inducing effect.

Depending on the context, here are a few ways to translate that sound natural in English:

**If the person is out of breath (exertion):**

*   "Pant... pant... pant..."

**If the person is breathing deeply/heavily (trying to calm down):**

**If the person is sleeping or snoring:**

*   "Hrr-shhh... hrr-shhh..."

**"Huff... huff... huff..."** is the most common and versatile choice for a character catching their breath.

Depending on the context, here are the best ways to translate the sound effect **“哐！”** (kuāng) into natural English:

**1. For a heavy door slamming:**
> **"Bang!"** or **"Slam!"**

**2. For metal hitting metal:**
> **"Clang!"**

**3. For something heavy hitting the floor:**
> **"Thud!"** or **"Crash!"**

**4. For a loud, sharp impact (like a box being dropped):**
> **"Bang!"**

**Recommendation:**
If you want the most versatile and common equivalent in English literature for this specific character, **"Bang!"** or **"Clang!"** are usually the go-to choices.

The translation of "**哗啦！**" depends heavily on the context, as it is an onomatopoeia for objects moving, breaking, or spilling. Here are the most natural options:

**If it refers to water or a heavy downpour:**
*   **"Splash!"**
*   **"Whoosh!"**

**If it refers to things falling, shattering, or being knocked over (like dishes or a stack of papers):**
*   **"Crash!"**
*   **"Clatter!"**
*   **"Clang!"**

**If it refers to paper, fabric, or something being pulled open (like curtains or a newspaper):**
*   **"Rustle!"**
*   **"Swish!"**

**If it refers to something being poured (like coins or marbles):**
*   **"Rattle!"**

**Recommendation:**
Without further context, **"Crash!"** (for solid objects) or **"Splash!"** (for liquid) are the most common uses. If you are describing a sudden movement of many small items, **"Clatter!"** is your best bet.

第125章 一更

第二天，夏兮风在秦琅的威胁下，先把房子扩建了。

他一边嘀咕着“那只是毛绒绒”，一边呼哧呼哧地盖房子。

光明小兽在一旁欲言又止。黑暗小兽高兴地在半空中飞着翻跟头，说了一大堆要求。

夏兮风好脾气地“嗯嗯啊啊”，能完成的都完成了，完不成的先记着，以后给屋子升级。

光明小兽犹豫了一下，也飞到夏兮风面前提要求。

黑暗神都提要求了，身为光明神不提点要求，好像这间屋子就变成黑暗神殿，自己成寄住的了。

秦琅抱着手臂旁观。

他除了旁观也做不了其他事，但夏兮风还是生气了，让秦琅滚出去刷怪，自己好吃经验。

正好埃德尔男爵和约翰神父一大早就来了，秦琅自我介绍后，就询问他们俩附近哪里有怪兽巢穴，或者强盗窝点也行。

埃德尔男爵惊讶：“你俩居然能一大早就起床？”

秦琅：“……”

埃德尔男爵干咳了两声：“刚回来就要离开吗？不在家里休息几天？”

正在改造房子的夏兮风凑上来：“休息什么？我都在干活，他不准休息，赶紧给我刷怪去！”

埃德尔男爵心道，难道是情侣生活不和谐，惹夏兮风生气了？

他怜悯地拍了拍秦琅的肩膀：“我正好要带兵去山里剿灭怪兽，开辟新的商道。你跟着我去。就是路途有点远，可能需要个几天。夏，刚见面就分别，你不会伤心？”

夏兮风疑惑：“晚上就能回来，伤什么心？”

埃德尔男爵：“晚上？”

金角马悠悠哉哉地路过。夏兮风顺手拿起一根萝卜递到金角马嘴里。

约翰神父：“金角马不吃萝卜，只吃拥有光明气息的香草。”

他话音未落，金角马就张开嘴把萝卜嘎吱嘎吱啃了，并用脑袋蹭了蹭夏兮风，还想再吃一根。

约翰神父：“……”金角马什么时候这么好养了？

别说约翰神父，光明小兽都很惊讶。

夏兮风拿出一堆自己收获的蔬菜，金角马全都能吃。

吃饱之后，它还露出很遗憾的神情，似乎垂涎得很。

约翰神父不敢置信。这些蔬菜他也吃过，和普通的蔬菜没区别啊。

“乖宝宝，辛苦你了。等传送卷轴做出来，你就不会太累了。”夏兮风胡噜胡噜金角马的耳朵。

金角马享受地低头让夏兮风胡噜。

约翰神父怀疑这不是真正的金角马，伸手也去摸金角马的耳朵。

金角马=皿=！！

约翰神父迅速缩回差点被咬的手。

夏兮风无奈道：“别学我啊，我对家里的动物有特殊的亲和力。”

系统更新后，他就冒出了一大堆生活技能，别说寻常的种地挖矿钓鱼，什么走路吃饭抚摸动物都有经验和技能条。

他在梦世界好不容易肝满了所有技能条，现在又得重肝。

开了新地图就要开新号吗？这是游戏必须重开新档的DLC吗？悟了悟了。

约翰神父做出祈祷的手势：“不愧是我主的恩赐者。”

光明小兽轻轻摇头。我不是，我没有，不是我的。

黑暗小兽可不管什么恩赐不恩赐，催促夏兮风赶紧给祂布置房子。

埃德尔男爵和约翰神父本来是来试探秦琅，没想到秦琅被夏兮风扫地出门。

埃德尔男爵观察秦琅。嗯，表情很平静，脾气很好，一点都不危险的样子。

难道昨天是错觉？

埃德尔男爵带兵开辟商道，路上会花费不少的时间。秦琅本想让埃德尔男爵帮他标注地图，他自己去。但见到埃德尔男爵表面上很热情，内心对他有警惕，秦琅便懒得多言了。

他什么都没带。埃德尔男爵以为他要和自己一起吃饭。

谁知道到了饭点，秦琅便从空间背包里拿出热腾腾的饭菜，三荤两素一汤，还有饭后水果和甜点，看上去仿佛是刚做的。

秦琅：“一起吃吗？”

埃德尔男爵震惊：“你还在储物魔导器里放饭菜？”

秦琅：“嗯。”虽然他确实偶尔会放，但这次不是。这是夏兮风刚做好的。

夏兮风做完饭就塞进背包，秦琅立刻拿出来。等秦琅吃完，就把脏盘子塞回去，夏兮风洗碗。

【夏兮风：你就不能给我洗了再塞回来吗！】

【秦琅：没热水没洗涤剂。回来洗。】

两人又可以私聊了。一路上夏兮风啰嗦个没完，秦琅偶尔应个单音节敷衍一下。

如果是梦世界的同伴，一看就知道秦琅在和夏兮风聊天。这里还没有便携式远程联络魔导器，埃德尔只以为秦琅在走神。

他很好奇秦琅在思索什么，绞尽脑汁套秦琅的话。

秦琅一边用单音节应付夏兮风，一边用单音节应付埃德尔，完全不掩饰自己的敷衍。

埃德尔男爵很是无奈。不过他也松了口气。虽然秦琅不爱和人交流，但聊天都很礼貌地回了，是个很正常的孤僻的人，不像坏人。果然他之前感受到的危险是错觉吗？

就当埃德尔男爵这么想的时候，他们来到了怪物巢穴。

秦琅扫了一眼地图上的红点，让埃德尔男爵先驻扎在外围，他进去看看。

埃德尔男爵正好想看看秦琅的本事，便同意了。不过他要求和秦琅一同前去查探，两个人好互相照应。

秦琅：“好，但请男爵不要动手。”

“叫什么男爵？太生疏了，和夏一样叫我一声埃德尔叔叔。”埃德尔男爵爽朗道，“行，让我看看你的本事。”

秦琅对称呼不在意，说改口就改口，半点不推辞。

埃德尔男爵对秦琅的好感又多了几分。之前果然是错……错……嗯？

埃德尔男爵看着面前堆积如山的怪兽尸体，眼珠子都快瞪出来。

这么快就杀光了？杀就杀，你怎么还堆起来了？！

秦琅问道：“埃德尔叔叔，你需要怪兽素材吗？”

埃德尔男爵：“啊……需要……”

秦琅：“五五分如何？”

埃德尔男爵懵懵道：“你杀的，不用……”

秦琅：“我分给你们一半，你们别出手，帮我聚怪。”

埃德尔男爵擦了擦眼睛：“你……是不是比之前强大了一点？”

他好歹也是个隐居的传说剑士，一眼就看出秦琅的实力增长。

秦琅点头：“我需要战斗经验。”

埃德尔男爵为了进一步观察秦琅，同意了秦琅的请求。

很快，他的心情就和已经回到黑暗神殿的黑暗骑士罗兰一样了。

他见到秦琅越杀越强，好像能从杀戮中夺取力量，仿佛天生为杀戮而生的怪物。

这样可怕的杀戮，秦琅会不会被杀戮蒙蔽了内心理智，真的变成只会杀戮的怪物？

秦琅停下了刷怪。他让埃德尔男爵带人来分怪物尸体。

埃德尔男爵见秦琅把怪物尸体都塞进了储物魔导器，再次震惊：“你的储物魔导器到底有多大？”

秦琅：“不太大。我的储物魔导器的空间和夏兮风共通，我送回农场了。”

埃德尔男爵：“？？？”还有这么神奇的储物魔导器吗？

秦琅：“是神送的。”
