第130章 一更

在连神灵都不能窥见的世界核心中，银色光海沉沉浮浮，似乎要与世界核心合为一体。

【……我有点生气。】

一声很轻很轻的声音响起，仿佛来自很遥远很遥远的地方。

银色光海剧烈震荡，出现了一个很大的漩涡。光海朝着漩涡收缩，凝聚成一个面目模糊的发光人体。

“啊……咳咳……”人影好像很久没说话，张嘴的时候竟不习惯自己的声音了。

干咳了好几声，他才将双手捧在嘴边做喇叭状，用尽浑身力气大喊道：“哎？没有啊！我只是在晋级变强，才没有不爱惜自己！别胡说，不准生气！”

【行，我信你。】

人影放下双手，面目越来越清晰，光亮越来越微弱。

夏兮风脸上出现庆幸的表情。

还好及时听到了。不然秦琅可太难哄了。

夏兮风揉了揉脸，伸了个大大的懒腰，又做了一套伸展体操。

许久没有恢复人形，他有点不适应自己人形的模样，得习惯习惯。

“唉，你能不能老实点，我不可能和你合为一体的。阿琅还在外面等着我呢。”夏兮风叉着腰，对缩成小球的世界核心道，“老老实实把知识吐出来，别做多余的事。”

小球不甘心地跳了跳，似乎不肯放弃。

夏兮风挠了挠头，很无奈。

破灭世界的残影即使知道自己已经破灭，仍旧想抓住一切机会求生。

当祂觉察到夏兮风来自其他救世主的世界后，就想和夏兮风合为一体，看能不能改变自己既定的命运。

合体不是吞噬，和世界本源合为一体，不会伤害到夏兮风。

夏兮风的实力会暴增。如果世界还活着，他能与天地同寿；如果世界还是死了，他不会和世界同死，还可能得到世界的遗产。

唯一的问题是，与世界本源合体，夏兮风会沉睡很多年才能消化世界规则。

秦琅还在外面等着他呢！

而且与别的东西合体后，夏兮风不确定自己还是不是原本的自己。即使他拥有“夏兮风”的外貌和记忆，可内里加了点别的东西，总感觉自己有一点点不纯粹。

以秦琅情感的纤细程度，夏兮风怀疑秦琅会钻牛角尖。

所以夏兮风感受到了世界本源的善意，也知道与世界本源融合是许多强者梦寐以求的事，不会影响他将来超脱，但他还是十分感动地拒绝了。

生存是所有有生命的存在的最基本的欲/求。哪怕知道希望几乎不存在，世界也想再挣扎一次，所以锲而不舍地向夏兮风展现自己的一切。

世界本源没有强迫夏兮风做什么。夏兮风留在这里，实力就能飞速上升；如果夏兮风在窥伺世界规则的时候一不留神和世界本源同化了，那就是夏兮风自己的选择。

夏兮风是个倔强不服输的人，世界本源敢展露自己，他就敢看。

有人在外面等着自己，他才不会和世界本源同化呢。

“我劝你放弃吧，别白费力气，不如积攒起来给你的创世神一记狠的。”夏兮风坐在小球旁边，“或许对经历了无数年，诞生了无数生灵的你而言，不能理解两个渺小的人类之间的感情。但我们人类的心就是这么小。”

好不容易恢复了人形，话痨夏兮风赶紧多说点话，絮絮叨叨和世界本源说起自己和秦琅的过去。

所有人都说他对秦琅很偏爱，但夏兮风逐渐理清自己的心后，明白他对秦琅的“偏爱”，来自秦琅对他的“偏爱”。

“阿琅老说他离精神病只有一线，与普通人思想不同。”夏兮风笑了笑，道，“我不也一样？”

什么救世主性格，虽然是正面的“与众不同”，不也是与众不同吗？

夏兮风一直都知道自己与众不同。

小时候不清楚，等他长大了，看了很多书，接触了很多人，他哪能不清楚自己老想做好事，还不计较回报的性格怪怪的。

做好事的人很多，做好事不求回报的人很多，但不求回报不代表别人的回应是恩将仇报的时候，心里不会难过。

只要是个正常人，被夸奖了会开心自豪，被伤害了会难过愤怒，这才是人之常情。

夏兮风却不是这样。

做好事是他的爱好，他不仅不在意回报，也不在意别人的回应。

这真的很奇怪。

虽然奇怪，但他是个好人，一个在大众眼中品德高尚的人，所以虽然有人担忧他的安全，只要他做好万全的准备，别人不会禁止他做好事。

只有秦琅，会让他自私些。

万全的准备也不是万无一失，做好事不求回报只会让别人得寸进尺。哪怕他只要被“背叛”一次就不会对那个人再伸出援手，但许多夏兮风做的好事都是针对陌生人，陌生人也不需要再让夏兮风伸出一次援手，这根本不算威慑。

“对阿琅而言，我才是最重要的。”夏兮风不好意思地揉了揉鼻子，颇为骄傲道，“就算我不是个好人也没关系！他还更高兴呢！”

世界本源如果能模拟出露水，一定会给自己的小球笼罩上雾水。

真是满头雾水啊，你究竟骄傲个什么啊！

夏兮风知道别人不能理解，正如他不在乎别人对他做好事的回应一样，他也不在意别人是否理解。

他只是想说而已。

“虽然穿越是一件好事，但一想到我差点连累阿琅陪我一起死，我就后悔了。”夏兮风笑容淡去，“我第一次后悔，为什么要去见义勇为。”

“所以你别再尝试了，我是不可能与世界本源融合的。即使你再说多少次不会有危险，但我不会再冒未知的危险。”夏兮风认真道，“因为我出事，阿琅会跟着我出事。我想帮助这个世界，前提是不伤害到阿琅。”

天生的救世主也是人，如果救世行为会伤害到自己重要的人，他也不想当这个救世主。

而重要的人的安危在于自己的安危，自己必须活着重要的人才会幸福，那他就必须爱惜自己胜过爱世。

“赶紧干活，早点干完活，我早点回去。”夏兮风笑眯眯地拍了拍世界球球，“阿琅还在等着我呢。唉，往外面递消息越来越费劲，我都寂寞了。”

世界球球抖了抖，似乎被夏兮风的自我剖析雷得不轻。

夏兮风：“不然，你把阿琅也叫来？他也能用抄写技能，让他帮我一起抄写知识，效率更高。”

世界球球又抖了抖。

祂不放秦琅进来，就是知道秦琅的“自我”太强大，绝对不可能和祂融合，所以祂才不费这个力气。

而夏兮风是天生的救世主，救世主的“自我”都是很薄弱的。

真不知道谁设置的“护道者”配置。谁会专门培养救世主的自私之心啊？！

不过……

稚嫩的世界意识看着夏兮风的双眼。

夏兮风眼中满是对未来美好生活的希望。有希望，这样的救世主会很难死吧？

世界不需要担心救世主会放弃救世，祂们只担心救世主奋不顾身，太容易死了。

所以“护道者”是必须的。

Chapter 130: First Update (Part 1)

In the core of the world, where even gods could not peer, a silver ocean of light rose and fell, as if it were about to merge with the world's core.

【...I'm a little angry.】

A very, very soft voice rang out, as if coming from a very, very distant place.

The silver ocean of light vibrated violently, creating a large vortex. The ocean of light contracted toward the vortex, condensing into a glowing human figure with blurred features.

"Ah... cough, cough..." The figure seemed unaccustomed to his own voice, as if he hadn't spoken in a long time.

After coughing several times, he cupped his hands around his mouth like a megaphone and shouted with all his might: "Eh? No, I'm not! I'm just leveling up and getting stronger; I'm not being reckless with myself! Don't talk nonsense, you're not allowed to be angry!"

【Fine, I believe you.】

The figure lowered his hands, his features becoming clearer and his light growing dimmer.

A look of relief appeared on Xia Xifeng’s face.

*Good thing I heard him in time. Otherwise, Qin Lang would be too hard to coax.*

Xia Xifeng rubbed his face, stretched his arms wide, and did a set of stretching exercises.

Having not returned to human form for a long time, he was a bit unaccustomed to it and needed to get used to it again.

"Sigh, can you be honest? I can't possibly merge with you. A-Lang is still waiting for me outside." Xia Xifeng stood with his hands on his hips, speaking to the world core that had shrunk into a small ball. "Just honestly spit out the knowledge and don't do anything extra."

The little ball jumped unwillingly, seemingly refusing to give up.

Xia Xifeng scratched his head, feeling helpless.

The remnant shadow of a destroyed world, even knowing it had already been destroyed, still wanted to seize every opportunity to survive.

When it realized that Xia Xifeng came from a world of other saviors, it wanted to merge with him to see if it could change its predetermined fate.

Merging was not devouring; merging with the world's origin would not harm Xia Xifeng.

Xia Xifeng’s strength would skyrocket. If the world were still alive, he could live as long as heaven and earth; if the world were still destined to die, he wouldn't die with it and might even inherit the world's legacy.

The only problem was that by merging with the world's origin, Xia Xifeng would have to sleep for many years to digest the world's rules.

Qin Lang was still waiting for him outside!

Moreover, after merging with something else, Xia Xifeng wasn't sure if he would still be himself. Even if he possessed the appearance and memories of "Xia Xifeng," if there was something else added inside, he would feel a little impure.

Given the delicacy of Qin Lang’s emotions, Xia Xifeng suspected that Qin Lang would get stuck in a loop of negative thinking.

So, although Xia Xifeng felt the goodwill of the world's origin and knew that merging with it was something many powerhouses dreamed of—and that it wouldn't affect his future transcendence—he still refused, albeit with great emotion.

Survival was the most basic desire of all living beings. Even knowing the hope was almost non-existent, the world wanted to struggle one more time, so it persistently showed Xia Xifeng everything it had.

The world's origin did not force Xia Xifeng to do anything. If Xia Xifeng stayed here, his strength would rise rapidly; if he accidentally assimilated with the world's origin while peering into its rules, that would be his own choice.

Xia Xifeng was a stubborn person who refused to admit defeat. If the world's origin dared to reveal itself, he dared to look.

Since someone was waiting for him outside, he would never assimilate with the world's origin.

"I advise you to give up. Don't waste your effort; it's better to save it up and give your Creator God a hard hit." Xia Xifeng sat down next to the little ball. "Perhaps to you, having been born for countless years and given birth to countless lives, you cannot understand the feelings between two tiny humans. But our human hearts are just this small."

Having finally regained his human form, the chatterbox Xia Xifeng hurried to speak more, rambling on to the world's origin about his and Qin Lang’s past.

Everyone said he was biased toward Qin Lang, but as Xia Xifeng gradually sorted out his own heart, he realized his "bias" toward Qin Lang stemmed from Qin Lang’s "bias" toward him.

"A-Lang always says he's only a hair's breadth away from being a psychopath and that his thinking is different from ordinary people." Xia Xifeng smiled. "Aren't I the same?"

What "savior personality"—even if it was a positive "being different," wasn't it still being different?

Xia Xifeng had always known he was different.

He didn't realize it when he was a child, but as he grew up, read many books, and met many people, how could he not know that his habit of always wanting to do good deeds without expecting anything in return was strange?

There were many people who did good deeds, and many who did them without seeking reward, but not seeking reward didn't mean one wouldn't feel sad when others responded with ingratitude.

As long as one was a normal person, one would feel happy and proud when praised, and sad and angry when hurt—that was human nature.

But Xia Xifeng wasn't like that.

Doing good was his hobby; he not only didn't care about rewards, he didn't care about others' responses.

This was truly strange.

Although it was strange, he was a good person—a person with high moral character in the eyes of the public—so although some worried about his safety, as long as he made thorough preparations, no one would forbid him from doing good.

Only Qin Lang would tell him to be more selfish.

Thorough preparation wasn't foolproof, and doing good without seeking reward only made others push their luck. Even if he wouldn't help someone again after being "betrayed" once, many of the good deeds Xia Xifeng did were for strangers, and strangers didn't need him to help them a second time, so that wasn't a deterrent at all.

"To A-Lang, I am the most important thing." Xia Xifeng rubbed his nose, feeling embarrassed but quite proud. "Even if I'm not a good person, it doesn't matter! He’d be even happier!"

If the world's origin could simulate dew, it would definitely have covered its little ball in mist.

*I'm completely confused—what exactly are you proud of?!*

Xia Xifeng knew others couldn't understand, just as he didn't care about others' responses to his good deeds; he didn't care if others understood him, either.

He just wanted to say it.

"Although traveling through time was a good thing, the moment I thought I almost dragged A-Lang down to die with me, I regretted it." Xia Xifeng’s smile faded. "It was the first time I regretted being a Good Samaritan."

"So don't try anymore. It's impossible for me to merge with the world's origin. Even if you say a thousand times that there's no danger, I won't take unknown risks again." Xia Xifeng said seriously. "Because if something happens to me, A-Lang will suffer too. I want to help this world, but the prerequisite is not to hurt A-Lang."

A born savior was still a human. If saving the world would hurt his important person, he didn't want to be that savior.

And since the safety of his important person depended on his own safety—he had to be alive for his important person to be happy—he had to cherish himself more than he cherished the world.

"Hurry up and get to work. The sooner we finish, the sooner I can go back." Xia Xifeng smiled and patted the world ball. "A-Lang is still waiting for me. Sigh, it's getting harder and harder to send messages outside; I'm getting lonely."

The world ball shivered, seemingly shocked by Xia Xifeng’s self-analysis.

Xia Xifeng: "Otherwise, why don't you call A-Lang in too? He can use the transcription skill too. Let him help me copy the knowledge; it'll be more efficient."

The world ball shivered again.

It didn't let Qin Lang in precisely because it knew Qin Lang’s "self" was too powerful and it would be impossible to merge with him, so it didn't waste the effort.

But Xia Xifeng was a born savior, and the "self" of a savior was always very weak.

I really don't know who set up the "Guardian" configuration. Who would specifically cultivate a savior's selfishness?!

However...

The immature world consciousness looked into Xia Xifeng’s eyes.

Xia Xifeng’s eyes were full of hope for a beautiful future. With hope, such a savior would be hard to kill, right?

The world didn't need to worry about the savior giving up on saving the world; they only worried about the savior being reckless and dying too easily.

Therefore, a "Guardian" was necessary.

chunks.chineseText:
他们护的不仅是先知的身，更是先知的心。有“护道者”这个锚点，先知才会重视自身，无数次从危险中归来。

而且只有重视自身，才会有“自我”。夏兮风只是夏兮风，不是什么被救世主性格异化的符号。他也有与拯救世界无关的自私梦想，比如和秦琅永远不分离，如他自记事起一样。

只有秦琅想要离开的时候，夏兮风会无数次地奔向秦琅，把秦琅的手牢牢抓住，不准秦琅离开。

不过……嗯，夏兮风回忆过往，虽然秦琅无数次嘴上说着要离开，行为上好像没离开过？

就是大学分离了两年，但他们每天还一起打游戏呢，日常都没断过。这算哪门子的分离？

夏兮风又沉浸在和秦琅的回忆中了。

世界小球瘪了瘪，像是叹了口气。

空间震荡，出现一个小小的洞口。

一朵“水母”滑了进来。

夏兮风眼睛一亮，扑了上去，将自己埋在了水母中：“阿琅！你还真变成水母了！”

水母瞬间变色，重新变回灰黑色。

夏兮风在触须中笑得打滚，嘲笑秦琅死要面子。

触须把夏兮风抓起来放好，然后变成了人形的模样。

秦琅揽住挂在他脖子上嘲笑他的夏兮风，双眼如刀子般剜向世界小球：“恩将仇报的东西，杀了吧。”

“哈哈哈哈，和世界本源融合不算恩将仇报吧？”夏兮风笑得趴在秦琅怀里起不来，“再说了，祂本来就是死的。”

秦琅嘴角抽搐了一下。

“人”死为大。算了，不和已死的世界计较。

“好多知识，根本抄不完，来帮我！”夏兮风嚷嚷。

秦琅：“嗯。”

他分出一个分身干杂活，本体和夏兮风一起睡了。

夏兮风睡多久，他就睡多久。

夏兮风的神体又变成了光的海洋，灰黑色的触须在海洋中沉沉浮浮。每一滴海水中，都有细小的触须游荡。

世界本源小球缩了缩。

咦！原本神圣的光之海洋中全是脏东西！

【阿琅啊，我说真的，你还是变成水晶丝触须吧。你这样好像我的水体被污染了。】

【水体污染？！】

世界本源小球上下晃动，疑似点头。

【我实话实说你怎么还生气啦？唉，你这人真小气，我说实话你都要生气。心胸好狭隘啊。】

【闭嘴。干活。】

【好久没和你说话了，我就要说，我就要说。】

【。】

【要不，我给你唱首歌吧！】

【……】

秦琅实在是不堪其扰，无奈褪色。

他怀疑，世界诞生夏兮风，就是为了气死他:）。

作者有话要说：

上一章的小风视角。我说了小情侣一直甜甜蜜蜜锁死。秦琅跟着睡了是因为夏兮风把他拉过去了，一起干活呢，不是啥寂寞地自闭哈哈哈哈。

昨天熬太晚了，有点头疼，明天再补加更。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 130: First Update (Part 2)

They protected not only the Prophet's body but also the Prophet's heart. With the "Guardian" as an anchor, the Prophet would value themselves and return from danger countless times.

And only by valuing oneself could one have a "self." Xia Xifeng was just Xia Xifeng, not some symbol alienated by a savior personality. He also had selfish dreams unrelated to saving the world, such as never being separated from Qin Lang, just as he had been since he could remember.

Only when Qin Lang wanted to leave would Xia Xifeng rush toward him countless times, grabbing his hand tightly and refusing to let him go.

However... well, Xia Xifeng recalled the past. Although Qin Lang had said he wanted to leave countless times, he didn't seem to have actually left in his actions?

They had been separated for two years in college, but they played games together every day, and their daily routine had never been broken. What kind of separation was that?

Xia Xifeng was immersed in memories of Qin Lang again.

The world ball deflated, as if sighing.

Space vibrated, and a small hole appeared.

A "jellyfish" slid in.

Xia Xifeng’s eyes lit up, and he pounced on it, burying himself in the jellyfish: "A-Lang! You really turned into a jellyfish!"

The jellyfish instantly changed color, turning back to gray-black.

Xia Xifeng rolled around laughing in the tentacles, mocking Qin Lang for being too proud to admit he cared.

The tentacles grabbed Xia Xifeng and set him down, then transformed into a human shape.

Qin Lang pulled Xia Xifeng, who was hanging on his neck and mocking him, into his arms. His eyes glared like knives at the world ball: "An ungrateful thing. Let's kill it."

"Hahaha, merging with the world's origin doesn't count as ingratitude, right?" Xia Xifeng laughed so hard he couldn't get up from Qin Lang’s arms. "Besides, it's already dead."

Qin Lang’s mouth twitched.

*The dead are the greatest.* Forget it. He wouldn't argue with a dead world.

"So much knowledge, I can't copy it all. Come help me!" Xia Xifeng shouted.

Qin Lang: "Mm."

He split off an avatar to do the busy work, and his main body slept with Xia Xifeng.

He slept for as long as Xia Xifeng slept.

Xia Xifeng’s divine body turned back into an ocean of light, with gray-black tentacles rising and falling within it. In every drop of seawater, tiny tentacles swam.

The world origin ball shrank.

*Eww! The originally sacred ocean of light is full of dirty things!*

【A-Lang, I'm serious, you should really change into crystal silk tentacles. You look like my water body is polluted.】

【Water body pollution?!】

The world origin ball shook up and down, seemingly nodding.

【Why are you still angry when I'm just telling the truth? Sigh, you're so petty, getting angry just because I told the truth. Your heart is so narrow-minded.】

【Shut up. Get to work.】

【It's been so long since I talked to you, I want to talk, I want to talk.】

【.】

【How about I sing you a song!】

【...】

Qin Lang was truly unable to bear the harassment and helplessly faded his color.

He suspected that the world had created Xia Xifeng just to annoy him to death :).

Author's Note:
The previous chapter was from Little Feng's perspective. I said the couple is always sweet and locked in. Qin Lang slept along because Xia Xifeng pulled him over to work together, not because he was lonely and self-isolating, haha.

I stayed up too late yesterday and have a bit of a headache. I'll add more tomorrow.

第131章 正文完结

文明的发展本不该由神灵亲自插手，知识的获取应该靠人类自己完成。

只有人类引领人类的发展，人类文明才是有源之水，有根之木，有地基的高楼大厦。

夏兮风直接引出世界本源的知识，是揠苗助长，饮鸩止渴。飞速发展的世界完全依托夏兮风，当夏兮风离开，或者世界的知识被获取耗尽，文明就会立刻停滞。人类不可能去探索世界之外的知识，文明也就不可能升等。

更可怕的是，文明的发展不仅仅是技术的发展，精神文化也得同步发展。

夏兮风的揠苗助长，就是让这个世界的凡人们小孩抡大锤。目前有光明神和黑暗神直接下场帮凡人们扶住锤子，社会才没有陷入动荡。

但如果神灵干涉凡人太多，相当于把婴孩装进坚固的摇篮里，婴孩无法凭借自己离开摇篮，学会走路。文明的虚假繁荣一定会停滞，世界进入慢性死亡。

换成任何一个健康发展的世界，夏兮风都不会做这等天打雷劈的坏事。如果他敢这么做，世界意识一定会攻击他。

可这个世界在命运中已经死了，那饮鸩止渴，揠苗助长也没关系了。

饮鸩止渴便不会在该渴死的时候死掉，揠苗助长哪怕长成空心树也比幼苗倒下时压得砍树人更疼。

夏兮风和秦琅进入世界本源的时候，哪怕有光明神和黑暗神联手为他们屏蔽气机，创世神也该发现这个世界的异常了。

但世界认可夏兮风和秦琅，创世神要驱逐夏兮风和秦琅，就只能亲自下场，以神皇的身份击杀夏兮风和秦琅。

神灵的时间流速和凡人不一样。创世神的“立刻”，在凡间就可能是几十上百年。

夏兮风和秦琅醒来的间隔越来越长，地面上好像按了倍速键。

宽广的道路瞬间铺就，道路上奔跑的车辆从畜力拉的马车，变得越来越奇怪；古朴的小城拆了建建了拆，房屋越来越精致；只有飞禽和飞行魔兽的天空中多了机器轰鸣声，与地面上的机器轰鸣声交相呼应……

山林越来越少，城镇越来越多，人类和魔族领地的界线逐渐模糊。

不知道从何时起，一些人类和魔族混在了一起，光和暗再不像以前那般黑白分明——对于魔力不强的普通人而言，因原本就很难使用魔法和斗气，使用机器却不需要魔力和斗气，属性便失去了意义。他们选择居住地不再以属性为前提，而是流向生活成本更低的地方。

从阶层上来说，这群混居者是最底层，他们创造的价值也是最低的。但阶层是个金字塔，这群在许多人眼中没有价值的混居者，数量却是最多的。

这群混居者形成了混沌的灰色，朦朦胧胧像是肮脏的雾气，席卷整个大陆。纯粹的光明和黑暗上出现了灰斑，像是难看的癣。

这种病症映现在了光明神和黑暗神的神体上。祂们完美的神体上出现了瘢痕，连象征纯粹美丽的光明神的容貌上都有了瑕疵。

祂们“生病”了。

夏兮风又在很长一段沉睡后醒来，看着掉毛的白色小兽和黑色小兽捧脸尖叫。

他叮铃哐啷掏出一大堆锅碗瓢盆、珍稀食材，给白色小兽和黑色小兽补身体。

黑色小兽抱着小短手使劲点头。是的，祂就是缺了夏兮风给祂做好吃的，营养不良了。夏兮风还不快补偿祂！

白色小兽不好意思地摸了摸掉毛的地方，拿出小扫帚扫毛。

夏兮风唠唠叨叨地拉着秦琅准备大餐。

秦琅捂住耳朵，看眼神已经是死了好一会儿了。

因抄书时被迫少说了很多话，夏兮风每次醒来时都要补上很多句话。

但夏兮风的被迫少说话只是对别人，他和秦琅神魂相融，随时都在秦琅脑海里絮絮叨叨，秦琅从未少听过他的啰嗦。

夏兮风从会说话起，就是这么吵，还专门对着秦琅的耳朵吵。

秦琅已经反省过很多次，自己究竟哪里想不开，才会和夏兮风纠缠在一起。

好像他出生后就和夏兮风一个摇篮？

好吧，是他出生的错。

晚上睡觉时，夏兮风和两只毛绒绒挤在一起。黑色小兽故意推夏兮风的脸，把夏兮风的脸都推歪了。

秦琅抱着被子去隔壁睡。

第二天起床，秦琅低头一看，自己被子里长出了一只夏兮风，夏兮风怀里还抱着两只毛绒绒。

光明神和黑暗神联手屏蔽了秦琅的感知，再加上秦琅对夏兮风本就不设防，让夏兮风偷袭成功。

他深深叹了一口气，捏起夏兮风的脸颊肉，把装睡的夏兮风掐醒。

夏兮风睁开眼，对秦琅讨好笑。

他怀里两只毛绒绒也睁大了水汪汪的眼睛。

秦琅：“……”你们两个神脑子有病吗？夏兮风说什么你们都照做？

“扑哧……”夏兮风把脸埋在秦琅颈间偷笑。

秦琅揉着夏兮风的后脑勺，那凶神恶煞的样子，仿佛要掀开夏兮风的头盖骨。

黑色小兽停止恶意卖萌，在枕头上笑得打滚。

白色小兽不好意思地挠了挠耳朵，转过身用尾巴对着秦琅。

运用光明和黑暗元素的人数急速减少，光明和黑暗的神域边缘崩裂成飞沙，裂痕蔓延到神座。

高坐在神座之上的最伟大的神明，迎来了属神的全面反叛。

神域的战火却没有蔓延到地面上。

文明仍旧蓬勃发展，许多古早的神灵被遗忘，人类开始探寻世界的每一个角落，试图用凡人的语言解释神灵。

光与暗的界线越发模糊，灰色的癣面积越来越大。

无名学院屹立在世界之上，左右世界政权更替，也影响高天之上的神灵之战。

而在藏书塔的顶楼，只有饭菜甜点飘香。

神界战得正酣，光明神和黑暗神的投影还在陪着夏兮风惹秦琅生气。

夏兮风做了一个超级大的蛋糕，大得可以把他自己装进去。

他试图扑进蛋糕里，被秦琅抓住后衣领。

秦琅抓住了夏兮风，就没能抓住黑色小兽。

黑色小兽如炮弹一般砸进蛋糕里，居然没把蛋糕砸塌。

祂钻进蛋糕里，又从蛋糕里吃到蛋糕外。

白色小兽拿着刀叉目瞪口呆，第一次发怒暴揍浑身都是奶油的黑色小兽。

夏兮风往后一倒，倒在秦琅身上捧腹大笑。

秦琅看着面前一片和乐融融，仰头看向透明穹顶外的天空。

空间剧烈动荡，世界意识在悲鸣。

在命运中已经杀死了这个世界的创世神“神皇”，即将降临。

今天丰盛的大餐和高大的蛋糕塔，是告别的宴会。

吃完大餐，夏兮风帮白色小兽和黑色小兽洗完澡。他牵着秦琅的手，走出了塔外。

约翰神父已经成了光明教皇，而黑暗教皇是秦琅的老熟人，黑暗骑士罗兰。

时间过去了许多年，但两人仍旧是中年人的模样——他们已经点燃神火，却没有攀登神界，去祈求神果。

“好久不见！”夏兮风仍旧是朝气蓬勃的青年人模样。他对着老熟人招招手。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 131: Main Story Conclusion

The development of a civilization should not be directly interfered with by gods; the acquisition of knowledge must be achieved by humanity itself.

Only when humans lead their own development can a civilization be like water from a living spring, a tree with deep roots, and a skyscraper built upon a solid foundation.

For Xia Xifeng to directly introduce knowledge from the world's origin was akin to pulling up seedlings to help them grow—a desperate, self-destructive measure. This rapidly advancing world relied entirely on Xia Xifeng; once he left, or once the knowledge provided was exhausted, civilization would immediately stagnate. Humans would be incapable of exploring knowledge beyond their world, and the civilization would never ascend.

Even more terrifying is that the development of a civilization is not merely about technological progress; spiritual and cultural growth must keep pace.

Xia Xifeng’s interference was like forcing a toddler to swing a sledgehammer. Currently, the God of Light and the God of Darkness were stepping in to help the mortals steady the hammer, which was the only reason society hadn't descended into chaos.

But if gods interfere too much with mortals, it is equivalent to trapping an infant in a sturdy cradle; the infant will never learn to leave the cradle on its own or learn to walk. The false prosperity of such a civilization would inevitably stagnate, and the world would enter a state of chronic decay.

In any healthy, developing world, Xia Xifeng would never commit such a heinous act. If he dared to do so, the world’s consciousness would surely strike him down.

But this world was already dead in the threads of fate, so it didn't matter if he resorted to such desperate measures.

Drinking poison to quench thirst at least prevents one from dying of thirst when they are meant to; even if pulling up seedlings makes them hollow, it is still less painful than being crushed when the sapling falls.

When Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang entered the world’s origin, even with the God of Light and the God of Darkness joining forces to mask their presence, the Creator God was bound to discover the anomaly in this world.

However, because the world recognized Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang, the only way for the Creator God to expel them was to descend personally and kill them in the guise of the God Emperor.

The flow of time for gods differs from that of mortals. A "moment" for the Creator God could be decades or even centuries in the mortal realm.

The intervals between Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang’s awakenings grew longer and longer, as if the world were playing at double speed.

Broad roads were paved in an instant, and the vehicles running upon them evolved from horse-drawn carriages to increasingly bizarre contraptions; ancient little towns were demolished and rebuilt, their houses becoming more refined. The sky, once home only to birds and flying magical beasts, was now filled with the roar of machines, echoing the mechanical cacophony on the ground.

Forests dwindled, towns multiplied, and the boundaries between human and demon territories gradually blurred.

At some point, humans and demons began to mingle. Light and darkness were no longer as black-and-white as before—for ordinary people without strong magic, since they were already incapable of using magic or Dou Qi, and machines required neither, their elemental attributes lost all meaning. They no longer chose their places of residence based on attributes, but rather flowed toward areas with lower costs of living.

In terms of social hierarchy, these mixed-dwellers were at the very bottom, and the value they created was the lowest. But hierarchy is a pyramid, and these people, whom many deemed worthless, were the most numerous.

These mixed-dwellers formed a chaotic gray, hazy like dirty mist, sweeping across the entire continent. Gray spots appeared on the pure light and darkness, like unsightly lichen.

This "illness" manifested on the divine bodies of the God of Light and the God of Darkness. Scars appeared on their perfect forms; even the God of Light, whose beauty symbolized purity, now bore blemishes.

They were "sick."

After a long slumber, Xia Xifeng woke up to see the small white beast and the small black beast clutching their faces and screaming.

He clattered about, pulling out a mountain of pots, pans, and rare ingredients to nourish the two little beasts.

The small black beast hugged its short arms and nodded vigorously. Yes, it was precisely because it lacked the delicious food Xia Xifeng made that it had become malnourished. Xia Xifeng had better make it up to them!

The small white beast shyly touched the patches where its fur had fallen out and pulled out a tiny broom to sweep up the hair.

Xia Xifeng nagged as he pulled Qin Lang along to prepare a grand feast.

Qin Lang covered his ears, his expression already dead inside.

Because he was forced to speak less while copying books, Xia Xifeng had to make up for all those lost words every time he woke up.

But Xia Xifeng’s forced silence only applied to others; his soul was fused with Qin Lang’s, and he was constantly chattering away in Qin Lang’s mind. Qin Lang had never missed a single word of his nagging.

Ever since he learned to speak, Xia Xifeng had been this noisy, and he specifically directed that noise into Qin Lang’s ears.

Qin Lang had reflected many times on what exactly he had been thinking to get himself entangled with Xia Xifeng.

It seemed they had been in the same cradle since birth?

Well, it was his own fault for being born.

At night, Xia Xifeng squeezed into bed with the two furry creatures. The black beast deliberately pushed Xia Xifeng’s face, distorting it.

Qin Lang took his quilt and went to sleep in the next room.

When he woke up the next day, Qin Lang looked down to find a Xia Xifeng growing inside his quilt, and in Xia Xifeng’s arms were the two furry creatures.

The God of Light and the God of Darkness had joined forces to mask Qin Lang’s senses, and coupled with the fact that Qin Lang never guarded against Xia Xifeng, the sneak attack had succeeded.

He sighed deeply, pinched Xia Xifeng’s cheek, and squeezed the feigning-asleep Xia Xifeng awake.

Xia Xifeng opened his eyes and gave Qin Lang a fawning smile.

The two furry creatures in his arms also opened their wide, watery eyes.

Qin Lang: "..." Do you two gods have something wrong with your brains? You do whatever Xia Xifeng tells you to?

"Pfft..." Xia Xifeng buried his face in Qin Lang’s neck to stifle a laugh.

Qin Lang rubbed the back of Xia Xifeng’s head, his fierce expression suggesting he was about to pry open Xia Xifeng’s skull.

The black beast stopped its malicious cuteness and rolled around on the pillow, laughing.

The white beast scratched its ears in embarrassment and turned around, presenting its tail to Qin Lang.

The number of people using light and dark elements plummeted, and the edges of the divine realms of Light and Darkness crumbled into flying sand, with cracks spreading all the way to the divine thrones.

The greatest gods, seated high upon their thrones, faced a full-scale rebellion from their subordinate gods.

Yet, the flames of war in the divine realm did not spread to the ground.

Civilization continued to flourish; many ancient gods were forgotten, and humans began to explore every corner of the world, attempting to explain the gods in the language of mortals.

The boundary between light and dark became increasingly blurred, and the area of the gray lichen grew larger.

The Nameless Academy stood above the world, swaying the changes in political power and influencing the war of the gods high above.

And on the top floor of the library tower, there was only the fragrance of food and desserts.

The divine realm was locked in fierce battle, while the projections of the God of Light and the God of Darkness were still busy helping Xia Xifeng annoy Qin Lang.

Xia Xifeng made a super-sized cake, big enough to fit himself inside.

He tried to dive into the cake, only to be grabbed by the back of his collar by Qin Lang.

Qin Lang caught Xia Xifeng, but he couldn't catch the black beast.

The black beast slammed into the cake like a cannonball, yet miraculously didn't cause it to collapse.

It burrowed into the cake, eating its way from the inside out.

The white beast stood there, knife and fork in hand, stunned, before finally losing its temper and beating the cream-covered black beast.

Xia Xifeng fell backward onto Qin Lang, clutching his stomach in laughter.

Qin Lang looked at the harmonious scene before him, then tilted his head to look at the sky outside the transparent dome.

Space was trembling violently; the world’s consciousness was wailing.

The Creator God, the "God Emperor" who had already killed this world in the threads of fate, was about to descend.

Today’s grand feast and the towering cake were a farewell banquet.

After finishing the meal, Xia Xifeng helped the white and black beasts bathe. He took Qin Lang’s hand and walked out of the tower.

Father John had become the Pope of Light, and the Pope of Darkness was an old acquaintance of Qin Lang’s—the Dark Knight, Roland.

Many years had passed, but both still appeared as middle-aged men—they had ignited their divine fires but had not ascended to the divine realm to seek the divine fruit.

"Long time no see!" Xia Xifeng still looked like a vibrant young man. He waved at his old acquaintances.

chunks.chineseText:
白色小兽坐在夏兮风的头顶。黑色小兽在满脸冷漠的秦琅头顶做窝。

约翰神父的笑容仍旧很慈祥：“好久不见。”

罗兰恭敬地鞠躬：“谢谢。”

“不用客气。”夏兮风笑着望向天空。他感觉到了充满威压的注视。那注视仿佛能压断世界的脊梁。

秦琅将头顶的黑色小兽摘下，递给罗兰。

白色小兽自己飞到了约翰神父的怀里。

【灭世的序章，从光明神和黑暗神被分食开始。】

一如已经注定的命运所言。

光明神和黑暗神被群神分食，只剩下最初最纯粹的光明和黑暗概念不可剥夺，但祂们已经如瘫痪的人，不能动弹。

群神正在弹冠相庆，天崩地裂。

神皇降临，带领不愿死去的神灵离开。

有德的神灵能登上方舟。方舟是光明和黑暗已经与世界意识融合的神躯。

即，已死的世界本身。

神灵是很难死的。融入了世界意识的光明和黑暗已经是半步超脱，祂们成为方舟，也相当于登上了方舟，一同来到了梦世界，造成梦世界灭世之灾。

之后，便是另一个世界的故事了。

夏兮风的双目中流淌着黄金的颜色，如太阳在双眼中灼烧。

他注视着这个世界的命运线，借着世界壁障的保护，直视着创世的神灵。

神皇降临，其力量是这个世界能承受的极限，即无限接近超脱。

祂伸出手指，要将胆敢进入祂的世界的外来虫子碾死。

光明和黑暗化为利箭，试图偷袭神皇。神皇轻描淡写地一挥手，便挥退了所有攻击。

这时，地面亮起无数光点。

神皇无视凡人的僭越。

凡人怎能伤害神灵？

“哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！”身体崩裂的黑暗神畅快大笑。

光明神抚摸着腐烂的半张脸，自诞生起第一次笑得如此灿烂肆意。

凡俗的光芒灼伤了神皇的手指，一滴神血落下。

神血飘到夏兮风和秦琅面前。

夏兮风和秦琅瞬间化作神体，银色的漩涡和黑色的漩涡融合在一起，吸入了神血，变成了一枚灰蒙蒙的巨卵。

神皇眉头轻皱，一掌拍向巨卵。

地面再次亮起无数光点。与此同时，神域也亮起无数光点。

神皇终于露出惊愕神情，反手防御住来自神域的袭击。

从古至今点燃神火的神灵身披战甲，如云般站在光和暗的身后，仿佛无限延伸的阴影。

“就算我们反叛，你也要带着我们去碰撞隔壁的世界，不能彻底杀死我们。”神灵们的声音层层叠叠，叠加成巨浪，“反正我们无论做什么，命运都已经注定，不如张狂一次。”

光明神和黑暗神往后仰倒，神灵坠落，概念被身后的属神撕成了碎片，只余下最初最纯粹的光明和黑暗。

祂们只剩下一具瘫痪的神躯。

世界的摇篮裂开一条缝，脆弱的婴孩对着摇篮之外伸出手。

分食了世界本源的神灵扑向了神皇，在神皇身上划出细细的伤痕，从伤痕处吮吸神血，如蚂蟥一般脆弱又恶心。

摇篮裂开，里面的婴孩只剩下一口气，身上都生了蛆。

祂还在坚定不移地往外爬，爬向摇篮之外。

灰色的巨卵不断律动，如世界的心脏。

世界本源正在注入外来者的身体。

祂不会与外来者融合，只是单纯成为外来者的力量。

“秦琅，我俩是劳务派遣，命运不写在世界之内，对吧？”

“嗯。”

“我们受到了梦世界的世界意识认可，可以在梦世界成神超脱，超脱后梦世界和原本世界的好处五五分，对吧？”

“嗯。”

“那这个世界的意识也认可我们了，我俩可不可以在这个世界超脱？啊，我知道超脱没那么容易啦。我的意思是，不需要真正超脱，只是在世界命运中印下‘可以超脱的种子选手出现’的烙印，有没有可行性？”

“烙印成功之前，神皇会阻止。”

“嘻嘻，如果神皇阻止不了，祂就只能用创世神的权柄，将你我驱逐出世界，那祂亲自下场，反噬就更重啰。试试呗，反正也就损失一具神躯。天父和咱家创世神在我们灵魂上留下了印迹，我们的本体在沉睡中。就算祂杀了我们，我俩也就是重伤而已。”

“伤势可能让我们以后超脱无望。”

“啧，你在意这个？”

秦琅想了想，确实不在意。

即使不能超脱，神灵的寿命也足够漫长。他和夏兮风本来只有短短不到百年时间相伴，现在寿命漫长到难以想象，他确实没有更进一步的执念。

夏兮风轻笑道：“再说了，如果为了超脱就苟命，失去了冲劲，怕是才会真正地难以超脱。我们可以被保送成神，但超脱之路，理应不会再有大家长为我们遮风避雨。”

秦琅转头，与牵着他的手的夏兮风对视。

他眼眸微垂，又重新抬起，与夏兮风对视的双眼中，浮现出罕见的清晰明朗的笑意。

这一瞬，秦琅一直戴在脸上的木讷碎裂，用以自我约束的冷漠坚冰消融。

夏兮风怔怔地看着秦琅那连他也很少见到的鲜活模样。

秦琅转身，将夏兮风环抱在怀里，轻轻吻了一下夏兮风的眼睛。

夏兮风不自知，但秦琅能看见。

这是他曾经以为的，他所爱的是夏兮风对他的偏爱，他所痴迷的是夏兮风对他的痴迷。

“好。”秦琅道，“别怕，我一直在。”

夏兮风犟嘴：“我主动提起的提议，怎么可能怕！”

秦琅：“那别抖。”

夏兮风：“……”

他头一低，撞在秦琅的下巴上：“呃……是有点怕。我怕很疼。”

秦琅的温柔瞬间化成了冷笑：“你怕疼？你怕疼还拿刀往自己身上扎？！”

夏兮风不高兴道：“那都多久前的事了，家庭生活和睦的秘诀就是别翻旧账！”

秦琅把夏兮风气人的脸按在自己胸口。

在外面看，他们的神体变成了一枚巨卵。

在巨卵“中央”，两人是拥抱着的人形。

夏兮风的神体凝实后重新化作人形很正常，秦琅的神体居然也是人的模样。

或许是不久之后，或许是很久之后，两人快忘记时间流逝时，莫大的恐怖笼罩住他们。

神魂破碎的疼痛太过剧烈，剧烈到时间都仿佛变慢了。

伤势直接作用在神魂上，灵魂没有生物体的疼痛保护机制，连痛得晕厥都是奢望。

夏兮风能清楚地感觉到自己是如何被碾碎。

但他心里没有恐惧，理智半点没有因疼痛而动摇。

“系统”包裹住夏兮风和秦琅几乎完全融合在一起的一点真灵，遁入了世界壁垒裂缝之外的混沌虚空。

离开之前，夏兮风用尽最后的力量，还向秦琅借了一把手，用他和秦琅的骨灰，在地上给神皇画了个凸。

……

“夏……”

夏兮风睁开眼睛，被一声轻呼唤醒。

龙皇刚碾碎了噩兆尸龙。

神灵濒死的怨气铺天盖地，吹得他神魂隐隐作痛。

夏兮风还在恍惚时，肩膀被揽住。
chunks.englishText:
The white beast sat atop Xia Xifeng’s head. The black beast made a nest on the head of the cold-faced Qin Lang.

Father John’s smile remained as kind as ever: "Long time no see."

Roland bowed respectfully: "Thank you."

"Don't mention it." Xia Xifeng smiled as he looked toward the sky. He felt a gaze filled with immense pressure—a gaze that seemed capable of snapping the world’s spine.

Qin Lang plucked the black beast from his head and handed it to Roland.

The white beast flew into Father John’s arms on its own.

【The prologue of the world’s destruction begins with the God of Light and the God of Darkness being devoured.】

Just as the destined fate had foretold.

The God of Light and the God of Darkness were devoured by the pantheon of gods, leaving only the initial, purest concepts of light and darkness that could not be stripped away. But they were already like paralyzed people, unable to move.

The gods were celebrating, while the heavens and earth crumbled.

The God Emperor descended, leading the gods who were unwilling to die away.

Virtuous gods could board the Ark. The Ark was the divine bodies of Light and Darkness, already fused with the world’s consciousness.

In other words, it was the dead world itself.

Gods are difficult to kill. Having merged with the world’s consciousness, Light and Darkness were already half a step toward transcendence; by becoming the Ark, they effectively boarded it, arriving together in the Dream World and causing the catastrophe of the Dream World’s destruction.

After that, it was a story for another world.

Xia Xifeng’s eyes flowed with the color of gold, as if the sun were burning within them.

He watched the fate line of this world, and with the protection of the world barrier, he stared directly at the Creator God.

The God Emperor descended, his power the limit of what this world could bear—infinitely close to transcendence.

He extended a finger, intending to crush the foreign bugs that dared to enter his world.

Light and Darkness transformed into arrows, attempting a sneak attack on the God Emperor. With a casual wave of his hand, the God Emperor brushed away all attacks.

At this moment, countless points of light ignited on the ground.

The God Emperor ignored the mortals' presumption.

How could mortals harm a god?

"Hahahahahaha!" The God of Darkness, his body crumbling, laughed heartily.

The God of Light stroked his rotting half-face, laughing more brilliantly and wantonly than he ever had since his birth.

The mortal light scorched the God Emperor’s finger, and a drop of divine blood fell.

The divine blood drifted before Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang.

Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang instantly transformed into their divine forms; the silver vortex and the black vortex merged, absorbing the divine blood and becoming a massive, gray-hued egg.

The God Emperor frowned slightly and struck the giant egg with his palm.

Countless points of light ignited on the ground once more. Simultaneously, countless points of light also ignited within the divine realm.

The God Emperor finally revealed a look of astonishment, turning his hand to defend against the attack coming from the divine realm.

Gods who had ignited their divine fires from ancient times stood clad in armor, like clouds behind the Light and Darkness, appearing as an infinitely extending shadow.

"Even if we rebel, you must take us with you to collide with the neighboring world; you cannot completely kill us." The voices of the gods layered upon one another, stacking into a giant wave. "Regardless of what we do, fate is already sealed, so we might as well be reckless once."

The God of Light and the God of Darkness tilted backward; the gods fell, their concepts torn into fragments by the subordinate gods behind them, leaving only the initial, purest light and darkness.

They were left with nothing but a paralyzed divine shell.

A crack appeared in the world’s cradle, and the fragile infant reached out beyond it.

The gods who had devoured the world’s origin lunged at the God Emperor, carving thin wounds into his body and sucking the divine blood from them, as fragile and disgusting as leeches.

The cradle split open, and the infant inside had only a breath left, its body infested with maggots.

Yet it was still crawling firmly outward, toward the world beyond the cradle.

The gray giant egg pulsed rhythmically, like the heart of the world.

The world’s origin was being injected into the bodies of the outsiders.

It would not fuse with the outsiders; it would simply become their power.

"Qin Lang, we are labor dispatch, our fate isn't written within this world, right?"

"Yes."

"We’ve been recognized by the world consciousness of the Dream World; we can become gods and transcend there. After transcendence, the benefits of the Dream World and the original world are split fifty-fifty, right?"

"Yes."

"Then this world’s consciousness has recognized us too. Can we transcend in this world? Ah, I know transcendence isn't that easy. I mean, we don't need to truly transcend, just leave a mark in the world’s fate that says 'a potential candidate for transcendence has appeared.' Is that feasible?"

"The God Emperor will stop us before the mark is successful."

"Heehee, if the God Emperor can't stop us, he can only use the Creator God’s authority to expel us from the world. If he descends personally, the backlash will be even heavier. Let’s try it. At worst, we lose a divine body. The Heavenly Father and our own Creator God left marks on our souls; our true bodies are in slumber. Even if he kills us, we’ll only be severely injured."

"The injuries might make transcendence impossible for us in the future."

"Tsk, do you care about that?"

Qin Lang thought about it; he really didn't.

Even without transcendence, a god’s lifespan was long enough. He and Xia Xifeng originally only had less than a hundred years together; now that their lifespans were unimaginably long, he truly had no obsession with going further.

Xia Xifeng chuckled: "Besides, if we play it safe just to transcend and lose our drive, I’m afraid that’s when transcendence would truly become impossible. We can be fast-tracked to godhood, but on the path of transcendence, there shouldn't be any 'parents' left to shield us from the wind and rain."

Qin Lang turned his head and met the eyes of Xia Xifeng, who was holding his hand.

He lowered his gaze, then lifted it again, and in the eyes that met Xia Xifeng’s, a rare, clear, and bright smile emerged.

In that instant, the wooden mask Qin Lang had worn for so long shattered, and the cold ice he used to restrain himself melted away.

Xia Xifeng stared blankly at the vibrant expression on Qin Lang’s face, one he rarely saw.

Qin Lang turned, wrapped his arms around Xia Xifeng, and gently kissed his eyes.

Xia Xifeng didn't know it, but Qin Lang could see.

This was what he had once thought: that what he loved was Xia Xifeng’s favoritism toward him, and what he was obsessed with was Xia Xifeng’s obsession with him.

"Okay," Qin Lang said. "Don't be afraid, I’m always here."

Xia Xifeng retorted: "I was the one who proposed it, how could I be afraid!"

Qin Lang: "Then stop shaking."

Xia Xifeng: "..."

He lowered his head and bumped it against Qin Lang’s chin: "Uh... I am a little afraid. I’m afraid it will hurt."

Qin Lang’s tenderness instantly turned into a cold sneer: "You’re afraid of pain? You’re afraid of pain, yet you used to stab yourself with a knife?!"

Xia Xifeng said unhappily: "That was ages ago! The secret to a harmonious family life is not to dig up old history!"

Qin Lang pressed Xia Xifeng’s infuriating face against his chest.

From the outside, their divine bodies had become a giant egg.

In the "center" of the egg, the two were human figures in an embrace.

It was normal for Xia Xifeng’s divine body to solidify back into human form, but Qin Lang’s divine body was also in the shape of a man.

Perhaps shortly after, or perhaps a long time later, just as they were about to forget the passage of time, a great terror enveloped them.

The pain of their divine souls shattering was too intense—so intense that time itself seemed to slow down.

The injuries acted directly upon their souls; the soul lacks the biological pain-protection mechanism of a physical body, so even fainting from the pain was a luxury.

Xia Xifeng could clearly feel how he was being crushed.

But there was no fear in his heart; his reason did not waver in the slightest due to the pain.

The "System" enveloped the sliver of true spirit—where Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang were almost completely fused—and escaped into the chaotic void beyond the cracks in the world barrier.

Before leaving, Xia Xifeng used his last bit of strength to borrow a hand from Qin Lang, using their ashes to draw a 'convex' symbol on the ground for the God Emperor.

...

"Xia..."

Xia Xifeng opened his eyes, awakened by a soft call.

The Dragon Emperor had just crushed the Omen Corpse Dragon.

The overwhelming resentment of a dying god filled the air, making his divine soul ache faintly.

While Xia Xifeng was still in a daze, his shoulder was pulled into an embrace.

chunks.chineseText:
他侧头看去，秦琅与他并肩而立，支撑着他的身体。

夏兮风道：“老秦，你怎么有点站不稳啊？”

秦琅：“你说呢？不记得了？痛失忆了？”

夏兮风使劲晃了晃脑袋，深吸一口气：“师祖等等！我来收尾！”

龙神正准备焚尽噩兆尸龙的残骸，动作突然停滞。

祂困惑地回头，看着拖着秦琅扑过来的夏兮风皱眉道：“时空乱了一瞬。有人拨动了命运。你们干了什么？”

夏兮风没回答。他认真地问道：“师祖，你不会真的趁火打劫，把隔壁光明神睡了？”

龙神瞪圆眼睛：“什么叫趁火打劫？祂自愿的！其实也不是真睡，只是神魂融合了一下试试……”

夏兮风一拳揍在了龙神瞪圆的眼窝上。秦琅帮他禁锢了龙神的动作，虽然只有不到千分之一秒的时间，夏兮风这一拳也揍得又狠又准。

龙神捂着眼睛：“等等，你怎么能说出祂的真正神名？祂的世界已经毁灭，连见过祂的我都说不出祂的神名！”

“不告诉你。”夏兮风甩了甩手。龙神太硬了，他不知道有没有把龙神打疼，自己的手反正是很疼了。

夏兮风对着噩兆尸龙的残骸伸出手：“你在呼唤我对吗？我们成功，是不是？”

外神的神体残骸湮灭成飞灰。神灵死亡的怨气朝着飞灰聚拢。神怨和残骸灰烬融合后凝结成浑浊的结晶，飞到了夏兮风的手中。

【掉落“噩兆尸龙的悲鸣”：祂是已经毁灭的世界的亡灵。祂连亡灵都不是。】

【因为亡灵也“存在”，而毁灭的世界“不存在”。】

神怨安安静静，如同不存在。

龙神放下捂眼睛的手，眼圈有点肿。夏兮风那一拳还真把他打疼了。

“真奇怪。祂应该变成没有理智的怪物，怎么还能控制怨气？”龙神看了一眼神怨晶体，又好奇地看向夏兮风和秦琅。

刚才夏兮风和秦朗的气息突然消失，应该是天父拉他们“做任务”去了。他们做什么……

“你们的气息怎么变得这么虚弱？连神火都要熄灭了！”龙神惊讶道。天父拉先知和护道者做任务，不是都用他们的神魂投影，不会伤害本体吗？

“没事。死不了。”夏兮风从秦琅的装备栏取出自我神格。

秦琅从背后拥住夏兮风，融入了夏兮风的身体中。

两簇神火融为一体。夏兮风打了个响指，指间迸发火焰。

他把自我神格和神怨结晶一抛。神火落在自我神格和神怨结晶上滋滋作响。

龙神刚想说，外神的神格没有那么容易被炼化，连祂这个超脱者都做不到，自我神格和神怨结晶已经化成了一团黏稠的液体。

龙神差点咬了舌头。

“小风……”

“夏兮风！”

“小琅……”

“秦琅大笨蛋！”

夏兮风嘴角上弯。夏兮风体内的秦琅嘴角下撇。

“我们成功了……”“我们成功啦！”

神火中，小小的白色毛绒绒和黑色毛绒绒的身影一闪而过，黏稠的液体猛然塌缩。夏兮风摊开手掌，一枚薄薄的半透明晶片落在了夏兮风的掌心。

夏兮风的眼睛一合一张，双目被黄金色覆盖。

无数材料从他的背包里飞出，被神火熔炼成细丝，细丝缠绕成巨大的造物。

“老秦啊，加把劲，火力不够。”夏兮风嚷嚷。

龙神回过神，阻止道：“要做什么也不急于这一时啊！你们俩的神体都要破碎了！”

因为不知道夏兮风和秦琅在做什么，祂只能口头阻止，不敢动作。

夏兮风当然是不听的。

神火骤然增大，笼罩住了巨大的造物。造物的体积越来越小，最后缩小成两个巴掌大。

龙神揉了揉眼睛。

经常旅游，见多识广的祂没看错吧？这是个……微型光脑？

夏兮风把晶片往光脑接口处一插，光脑屏幕“滋滋”花屏，传出断断续续的声音。

“这里……”

“这里是……”

“……艾德文图拉。”

光脑的图像逐渐清晰，身穿黑金色长袍，头戴冠冕的中年男人看着屏幕外的人。

“这里是艾德文图拉。”

“我是艾德文图拉黑暗神殿教皇罗兰。”

“我们的创世神皇决定灭世。我们无法阻拦，只能留下世界最后的信息。”

“这枚晶片中有艾德文图拉所有种族的文明遗产。”

罗兰移开身体。

他的身后，创世神降下神威，抹掉了一枚正脉动着，似乎即将破壳而出的巨卵。

“请您见证，被创世神毁灭的艾德文图拉。”

【掉落物“艾德文图拉世界的墓碑”。】

【我们已死。】

【但我们存在。】

【墓碑即是存在的证明。】

……

比高天更高，比深渊更深，英雄的传说从不曾传颂，连伟大的神灵都不能窥见的世界之外，物质和精神的规则都无法描述的混沌虚空中，愤怒的咆哮声连地面上的凡人都能听到。

他们虽然听不清那怒嚎的语言，但能感受到声音中的怒气。

有一位伟大的存在发怒了。

祂的怒气成为了实质的威压，震慑得地面上没有开启灵智，只有趋利避害本能的怪物们都匍匐在地面，不敢抬头。

有灵智的人类却不愿意低头。他们抬起了脆弱的头颅，看向他们看不见的远方。

一声轻蔑哼笑声后，笼罩在梦世界上的恐怖威压骤然一空。

血月碎裂，银月如盘；

神树开花，花瓣飘落如雨，融入地面；

黑水褪去，碧蓝的海波中，手持利器的海族战士正在踏浪冲锋；

人族皇帝圣灵附体，撕开空间，军队在他身后集结，等候皇帝出征的命令；

精灵族圣地的圣泉干涸，曾经的圣地守卫一队接一队跳入圣泉底部的幽洞中；

矮人王踏入了地底岩浆，挥舞着斧头冲在最前面，矮人贤者们推着魔导炮在后面追；

深渊魔气如云，优雅的魔王们手持圣典《自我之神传记（夏兮风著）》，正进行战前动员……

莱欧和佩瑞拉手拉手，看着变大了一圈的希望之日泪流满面，哽咽大哭。

苏尔靠在阿穆若肩头，面白如纸，双眼泣血，笑容却异常灿烂。

“我看见……祂的心脏上扎上了一柄名为‘艾德文图拉’的复仇短剑。”

“哈哈哈哈哈，毁灭世界的神灵，一定会被世界毁灭，果然会被世界毁灭！”

“天父要赢了。”

阿穆若为苏尔擦拭窥伺不该窥伺的战争而流的血泪。

苏尔扬起染血的脸：“外神来自创世神的庇佑没了。阿穆若，去把祂们都杀了，让亡灵安息。”

“嗯。”阿穆若道，“稍等，我很快就回来。”

世界气机颤动。

正在给瘫在地上，已经分开躺尸的夏兮风和秦琅塞药的龙神惊讶看向远方。

啊，不是，我们的世界这么年轻，都有第二个超脱者了？！这合理吗？！！

天父是不是运气太过好了？怪不得惹隔壁创世神妒忌呢！
chunks.englishText:
He tilted his head and looked over. Qin Lang was standing side-by-side with him, supporting his body.

Xia Xifeng said, "Old Qin, why are you a bit unsteady on your feet?"

Qin Lang: "What do you think? Don't remember? Did the pain give you amnesia?"

Xia Xifeng shook his head vigorously and took a deep breath. "Grandmaster, wait! Let me finish this!"

The Dragon God was just about to incinerate the remains of the Omen Corpse Dragon when his movements suddenly stalled.

He turned his head in confusion, frowning at Xia Xifeng, who was dragging Qin Lang toward him. "Time and space fluctuated for an instant. Someone meddled with fate. What did you two do?"

Xia Xifeng did not answer. He asked earnestly, "Grandmaster, you didn't really take advantage of the chaos to sleep with the Light God next door, did you?"

The Dragon God’s eyes went wide. "What do you mean 'take advantage of the chaos'? It was consensual! And it wasn't really 'sleeping' together; it was just a fusion of our divine souls to test something..."

Xia Xifeng punched the Dragon God right in his wide-eyed socket. Qin Lang helped him restrain the Dragon God’s movements; although it lasted less than a thousandth of a second, Xia Xifeng’s punch was both ruthless and precise.

The Dragon God clutched his eye. "Wait, how could you even say His true divine name? His world has already been destroyed; even I, who have met Him, cannot speak His divine name!"

"Not telling you." Xia Xifeng shook his hand. The Dragon God was too tough; he didn't know if he had hurt the Dragon God, but his own hand was certainly aching.

Xia Xifeng reached out toward the remains of the Omen Corpse Dragon. "You are calling out to me, aren't you? We succeeded, didn't we?"

The divine remains of the Outer God disintegrated into ash. The resentment of the fallen deity gathered toward the ashes. After the divine resentment fused with the ash of the remains, it condensed into a turbid crystal and flew into Xia Xifeng’s hand.

【Dropped: "The Lament of the Omen Corpse Dragon": He is the undead of a destroyed world. He is not even an undead.】

【Because the undead still "exist," while a destroyed world "does not exist."】

The divine resentment was quiet, as if it did not exist.

The Dragon God lowered his hand, his eye socket slightly swollen. Xia Xifeng’s punch had actually hurt him.

"How strange. He should have turned into a mindless monster; how can he still control his resentment?" The Dragon God glanced at the crystal of divine resentment, then looked curiously at Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang.

The fact that Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang’s auras had suddenly vanished just now meant the Heavenly Father must have pulled them away to "do a mission." What could they have done...

"Why have your auras become so weak? Your divine fires are about to extinguish!" the Dragon God exclaimed in surprise. When the Heavenly Father pulls prophets and guardians for missions, doesn't He usually use projections of their divine souls? It shouldn't harm their true bodies, right?

"It's fine. We won't die." Xia Xifeng took his Self-Godhead from Qin Lang’s equipment slot.

Qin Lang embraced Xia Xifeng from behind, merging into Xia Xifeng’s body.

Two clusters of divine fire fused into one. Xia Xifeng snapped his fingers, and flames burst from his fingertips.

He tossed the Self-Godhead and the crystal of divine resentment into the air. The divine fire crackled as it landed on them.

The Dragon God was just about to say that the godhead of an Outer God is not so easily refined—even He, a Transcendent, couldn't do it—when the Self-Godhead and the crystal of divine resentment had already melted into a viscous liquid.

The Dragon God nearly bit his tongue.

"Xiao Feng..."

"Xia Xifeng!"

"Xiao Lang..."

"Qin Lang, you big idiot!"

Xia Xifeng’s lips curled upward. Qin Lang, inside Xia Xifeng’s body, curled his lips downward.

"We succeeded..." "We succeeded!"

Within the divine fire, tiny white fluffy and black fluffy figures flashed by, and the viscous liquid suddenly collapsed. Xia Xifeng opened his palm, and a thin, translucent chip fell into it.

Xia Xifeng’s eyes closed and opened, his pupils covered in a golden hue.

Countless materials flew out from his backpack, melted into fine threads by the divine fire, and the threads wound themselves into a massive creation.

"Old Qin, put some effort into it! The firepower isn't enough!" Xia Xifeng shouted.

The Dragon God snapped out of his daze and tried to stop them. "Whatever you're doing, there's no rush! Both of your divine bodies are about to shatter!"

Because he didn't know what Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang were doing, he could only try to stop them verbally, not daring to interfere physically.

Xia Xifeng, of course, ignored him.

The divine fire surged, enveloping the massive creation. The volume of the creation shrank smaller and smaller until it was the size of two palms.

The Dragon God rubbed his eyes.

He traveled often and was well-informed, but he couldn't be seeing this right? This is a... micro-light computer?

Xia Xifeng plugged the chip into the light computer’s interface. The screen flickered with static, and a fragmented voice came through.

"Here..."

"This is..."

"...Adventura."

The image on the light computer gradually cleared. A middle-aged man wearing black and gold robes and a crown looked at the people outside the screen.

"This is Adventura."

"I am Roland, Pope of the Dark Temple of Adventura."

"Our Creator God-Emperor has decided to destroy the world. We cannot stop Him; we can only leave behind the final information of our world."

"This chip contains the civilizational heritage of all races in Adventura."

Roland moved aside.

Behind him, the Creator God descended with divine might, erasing a giant egg that was pulsing, seemingly about to hatch.

"Please bear witness to Adventura, destroyed by the Creator God."

【Dropped Item: "Tombstone of the Adventura World."】

【We are dead.】

【But we exist.】

【The tombstone is the proof of our existence.】

...

Higher than the high heavens, deeper than the abyss, in a place where heroic legends were never sung, beyond a world that even the great gods could not glimpse, in the chaotic void where the rules of matter and spirit could not describe, an angry roar could be heard even by the mortals on the ground.

Although they could not understand the language of that roar, they could feel the fury within the sound.

A great existence was enraged.

His anger became a tangible pressure, terrifying the monsters on the ground—who had no intelligence and only the instinct to seek profit and avoid harm—into prostrating themselves on the earth, not daring to lift their heads.

Yet, the intelligent humans refused to bow. They lifted their fragile heads, looking toward the distant horizon they could not see.

After a scornful scoff, the terrifying pressure shrouding the Dream World suddenly vanished.

The blood moon shattered, and the silver moon shone like a disk;

The Divine Tree bloomed, and petals fell like rain, merging into the earth;

The black water receded, and amidst the azure waves, Sea Clan warriors wielding sharp weapons charged forward on the surf;

The Human Emperor, possessed by a holy spirit, tore through space, his army gathering behind him, awaiting the order to march;

The holy spring in the Elf sanctuary dried up, and the former guardians of the sanctuary jumped, squad after squad, into the dark abyss at the bottom of the spring;

The Dwarf King stepped into the underground magma, waving his axe as he charged at the front, while the Dwarf Sages pushed their magitech cannons in pursuit;

Abyssal demonic energy swirled like clouds, and the elegant Demon Lords, holding copies of the holy scripture *Biography of the God of Self (Authored by Xia Xifeng)*, were conducting pre-battle mobilization...

Leo and Perilla held hands, tears streaming down their faces as they looked at the Hope Sun, which had grown a size larger, sobbing uncontrollably.

Sull leaned against Amuro’s shoulder, his face pale as paper, blood weeping from his eyes, yet his smile was exceptionally brilliant.

"I see... a vengeful dagger named 'Adventura' pierced into His heart."

"Hahahaha, the god who destroys the world will surely be destroyed by the world! It really will be destroyed by the world!"

"The Heavenly Father is going to win."

Amuro wiped away the blood-tears Sull shed for peeking at a war he should not have seen.

Sull lifted his blood-stained face. "The Outer God’s protection from the Creator God is gone. Amuro, go and kill them all. Let the dead rest in peace."

"Yes," Amuro said. "Wait a moment, I will be back soon."

The world’s energy trembled.

The Dragon God, who was busy stuffing medicine into Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang as they lay sprawled on the ground, looked toward the distance in surprise.

Ah, no, our world is so young, and we already have a second Transcendent?! Is this reasonable?!!

Is the Heavenly Father’s luck just too good? No wonder He attracts the jealousy of the Creator God next door!

夏兮风一边笑一边咳血：“肯定是阿穆若老师！阿穆若老师都超脱了，我的老师肯定也超脱了。说不定他们早就是超脱者，只是不声不响，闷声隐居。嘿嘿，我的老师们真厉害。以后我们也要这么厉害……咳咳咳咳……”

龙神回过神，继续塞药：“夏兮风！你闭嘴！少说话多吃药！”

秦琅默默吐血，默默被灌药。

即使他和夏兮风自出生就睡在同一个摇篮里，他也不能理解，都伤到动弹不得，七窍流血，身体都干瘪得快变成干尸了，夏兮风怎么还能说出这么一长串的话来？话痨难道也是什么概念性能力吗？

作者有话要说：

正文完结。

十月下旬开宋穿，宋穿写完后开耽美玄幻大长篇《我与龙傲天寿命共享》。以后历史文和耽美文仍旧轮流写，只看耽美的看官可以提前收藏着等我，文案如下：

萧瑱在娘胎里就中了奇毒，六岁遇袭经脉俱断，虽遇奇迹得了神功勉强续了经脉，成了名冠天下的九天门之主，时至弱冠，寿命也不过一载了。

当他被背叛时落入奇异秘境，增寿的灵丹妙药没遇到，却有一孱弱少年拿着石刀威胁自己，要与自己立下性命共享的契约。

“我的寿命只剩不到一载，你确定？”

“你、你别想反悔！你刚刚同意了！”

少年郎色厉内荏，握着石刀的双手微微颤抖。

居然有人主动要求短命，萧瑱叹气颔首：“行。”

穿越的陶煦得了至高传承，却一点都不高兴。

这个世界以武为尊，弱肉强食，自己小胳膊小腿的，还怀璧其罪，能活过几日？

没办法，他只好以性命要挟一个好人，求他保护自己了。

之后……

“阿兄就是最好的！最厉害的！最完美的！”

陶煦星星眼。

“不，阿煦才是最好的。”

萧瑱摸摸头。

萧瑱本以为这是两个短命鬼的故事，没想到他与他的阿煦携手武途，从凡俗的武林走向更广阔的世界，脱凡入圣，登临绝顶，竟一路奔着长生去了。

——

接下来是“后记”，后记是正文时间线上的真正结尾，不列入“番外”中，会影响订阅率；后记写完后的if线和竹马回忆全部列为“番外”，可以选择订阅，不会影响订阅率。

大家晚……早安_(:з」∠)_。

Xia Xifeng laughed while coughing up blood. "It must be Teacher Amuro! Teacher Amuro has transcended, so my teacher must have transcended too. Maybe they were already Transcendents all along, just quiet and living in seclusion. Hehe, my teachers are truly amazing. We have to be just as amazing in the future... *cough cough cough cough*..."

The Dragon God snapped out of it and continued stuffing medicine into him. "Xia Xifeng! Shut up! Talk less and take your medicine!"

Qin Lang silently spat blood and silently accepted the medicine being forced into him.

Even though he and Xia Xifeng had slept in the same cradle since birth, he couldn't understand how Xia Xifeng could still say such a long string of words when he was injured to the point of being unable to move, bleeding from his seven orifices, and his body was so withered he looked like a dried corpse. Was being a chatterbox also some kind of conceptual ability?

Author's Note:

The main story concludes here.

In late October, I will start a Song Dynasty transmigration novel. After that is finished, I will start the long-form BL fantasy novel *My Lifespan is Shared with the Dragon-Proud-Heaven*. From now on, I will alternate between historical and BL novels. Those who only read BL can add it to their collections in advance while waiting for me. The blurb is as follows:

Xiao Tian was poisoned while still in his mother's womb. At age six, he was attacked and his meridians were severed. Though he miraculously obtained a divine technique to barely sustain his meridians and became the master of the world-renowned Nine Heavens Sect, by the time he reached adulthood, he had less than a year to live.

When he was betrayed and fell into a strange secret realm, he didn't find any life-extending elixirs, but instead, a frail youth holding a stone knife threatened him, demanding to enter into a life-sharing contract.

"My lifespan is less than a year. Are you sure?"

"Y-you, don't you dare go back on your word! You just agreed!"

The youth was bluffing, his hands holding the stone knife trembling slightly.

To think someone would actively seek a short life. Xiao Tian sighed and nodded. "Fine."

Tao Xu, who transmigrated, obtained the supreme inheritance, but he wasn't happy at all.

This world respects martial arts and the law of the jungle. With his small limbs and the "crime" of possessing a treasure, how many days could he survive?

With no other choice, he had to threaten a good person with his life, begging him to protect him.

Afterward...

"Big Brother is the best! The most amazing! The most perfect!"

Tao Xu’s eyes sparkled.

"No, Xu is the best."

Xiao Tian patted his head.

Xiao Tian originally thought this was a story about two short-lived ghosts, but he didn't expect that he and his Xu would walk the path of martial arts together, moving from the mundane martial world to a broader horizon, transcending the mortal to enter the sacred, reaching the pinnacle, and actually heading toward immortality along the way.

——

The "if" scenarios and childhood memories written after the afterword will all be listed as "Side Stories," which you can choose to subscribe to; it will not affect subscription rates.

Good... morning, everyone _(:з」∠)_.

第132章 后记一

战争扫尾持续了五年才结束。

精灵们把世界树圣地变成了育苗圣地，各处收集神树果实后，在育苗圣地培育成树苗，再扛着小树苗在全世界种树。

树苗种下的地方，如毒蘑菇般的彩色天地重新变回单调朴素的绿水蓝天。

矮人们在贤者院的带领下探测各地异变的地下矿脉，打造地下堡垒把危险的地方圈起来。

人类会做的事太多，便成了一块砖，哪里需要哪里搬。不过他们更喜欢注册成佣兵，在各个禁地探险。

而与世隔绝的深渊恶魔正在积极和地面合作。毕竟仅靠他们恢复深渊环境，会把他们累死，效果还会很差。

末世虽然结束，但世界的异变要恢复还需要许多年。

战争扫尾时，在最初末世之战中大放异彩的希望之城城主夏兮风、秦琅就没有了存在感。

原因无他，这俩一直躺着养伤，足足躺了五年才升回传说。

解读出“艾德文图拉世界的墓碑”后的第一年，两人是睡过去的。

苏尔为他们打造了水晶棺，将当时还有意识的两人丢进去封印。

莱欧和佩瑞拉等夏兮风和秦琅的友人特意从战场回来探病，和不知道会睡多少年的好朋友告别。

他们看着水晶棺里长满灰黑色触须的银色发光黏稠玩意儿，都震惊无比。

“你别告诉我这是你们的神体？怎么和邪神似的？”莱欧说，“能不能选一个好看的神体？”

黏糊糊并且发光的夏兮风回答道：“能，但这样不会硌得慌。”

莱欧看着棺材里的“液体”般的夏兮风和他“怀里”的秦琅，不得不承认，这样确实不挑睡的地方，只要有个装水的罐子就成。

前世是邪神的辛格和原定命运会变成邪神的佩瑞拉大为震撼。而已经胖……大了好几圈的希望之日和水神对夏兮风、秦琅的选择点了个赞。祂们自然概念的神灵就喜欢这种方便舒适的神体，只有自我、智慧、进化等和人类相关的神灵才喜欢用人形。

莱欧手贱，想试试黏糊糊夏兮风的手感。

苏尔把莱欧提着后衣领丢出门，将所有探病的人都赶走，封闭了夏兮风和秦琅的养伤地。

神体破碎，神火熄灭。普通神灵得闭关个几十上百年才能稳固伤势。夏兮风和秦琅第二年就破关而出。

两人的境界跌落到最初刚入世界的时候，据说是“用经验值换了新身体”，从头开始练级。

不过身体换了，他们的神魂还伤着。两人当了五年的普通人，戴蒙快乐极了。

弱小的普通人就乖乖待在城里干活吧，我！传说强者戴蒙！将投身战场啰！

戴蒙留书出走，夏兮风和秦琅被堆积成山的城务埋没。谁不称一句一报还一报，活该？

伤得太重，两人好得很慢。五年后两人重登传说，还是因为主线任务结束的结算奖励。

末世结束，系统送来了大量经验和珍稀神药，夏兮风和秦琅终于修复了神魂，迅速登临传说。

阿穆若终于能本体回家。

他抱着手臂打量夏兮风和秦琅。

一般人在面对创世神的威压后都会留下很重的心理阴影，要重回境界很难。

夏兮风和秦琅被天父保护得很好，按理说应该缺乏绝地求生的历练，面对这个难关会更难过。

谁知道夏兮风和秦琅毫无心理阴影，还向对方创世神比了个中指。

阿穆若眉头挑动了一下，看向莱欧和佩瑞拉。

两位半身人疯狂摇头。

我不是，不是我。不是我们把风和琅教坏的！

“算了，活着就好。”阿穆若道，“那群神灵都伤得不轻，短时间内应该不会再出现灭世危机。你们可以放很长的假。”

夏兮风眼含希冀：“阿穆若老师，你的意思是，我们可以不当城主了？”

阿穆若微笑：“不，我的意思是，当城主等于放假。”

别说活泼好动的夏兮风，连秦琅都露出了丧丧的表情。

两人都不是喜欢权力的人，只觉得一城的琐事实在麻烦。

戴蒙大笑三声，直呼两位甩手城主活该。希望之城草创阶段是最忙碌的时候，两人居然携手跑路，把偌大的城池丢给他。虽然他们说是去拯救世界，但叔叔都能留个分身当城主，同样点燃神火的夏兮风和秦琅，绝对不可能做不到。

他们就是懒！

戴蒙冷笑道：“现在我已经点燃神火，你们还是传说，别想再偷跑。无论去哪，都留个分身干活！”

夏兮风扑到秦琅怀里假哭。

秦琅拍了拍夏兮风的背，和夏兮风一同饱受戴蒙淫威之苦。

不过夏兮风和秦琅还是跑路成功了。

主线任务最终奖励“回家”下发，他们要回家探个亲。虽然他们可以留个分身，但两人故意只留了一封信，赌的就是戴蒙已经对一手建立的希望之城感情很深，不可能对希望之城群龙无首的困境视而不见。

至于他们回来会不会被戴蒙暴揍……那是肯定会啊！

秦琅：“为什么你一定要挑衅戴蒙？”

夏兮风辩解：“人活着就是要挑衅一切。”

秦琅不认可夏兮风，但夏兮风都跑了，他当然也不能留下自己干活。有难同当有苦同吃，两人一同跑路，回来后一同被揍。

不过秦琅还是比夏兮风善良一些，提前通知了莱欧和佩瑞拉回来帮戴蒙分担城务。

虽然半身人动不动就想开宴会，但干活也还是很利落的。

可怜的猫猫管家好不容易和主人相处了五年，主人又丢下猫猫跑了。

为什么主人不能带着猫猫一起跑？我们可以给主人做饭跑腿洗衣服！猫猫很能干的！

夏兮风哭笑不得。

现在没了危险，他们旅游的时候确实可以带上猫大猫二，反正魔导车里房间很多，互不干扰。但他们要回地球啊，地球上可没有能直立行走的可爱猫猫人。

“走，老秦，咱们回家！”

“嗯。”

……

每年夏季暑假，各地都会进行防溺水提醒，但每年都有悲剧发生。

在梧城，这场悲剧撕心裂肺，震动全国。

事件发生才一天，搜救还没结束，媒体争相报道，网络热搜登顶……无论是只会看电视的老年人，还是已经摒弃电视只玩手机的年轻人，都记住了一个名字，“夏兮风”。

夏兮风为幼儿园小朋友挡刀并制伏歹徒的新闻又被人翻出来，看过的人无人不为年轻英雄的逝世落泪。

如果英雄是牺牲在见义勇为力有不逮时，还能说悲壮。可夏兮风死在“水鬼”夺命，就只会让人愤怒。

网红无视警告跑到浅滩中间拍摄大坝放水，夏兮风已经快把人都救上来了，那网红却把力竭的夏兮风推向浮木，导致夏兮风被砸沉水。

当时还有未成年玩水。夏兮风跳下水的时候，许多人也跟着救人。

夏兮风力竭的时候，岸上一些水性不好，不敢救人的人也接力入水，想给夏兮风搭把手。

当夏兮风被浮木砸中时，很多人都拿着游泳圈想去救人，其中就有夏兮风的好友秦琅。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 132: Afterword I

The cleanup of the war took five years to finish.

The elves turned the World Tree sanctuary into a nursery, collecting divine tree fruits from everywhere to cultivate saplings, then carrying the little trees across the world to plant them.

Wherever the saplings were planted, the colorful, poisonous-mushroom-like lands returned to the monotonous, simple green waters and blue skies.

Under the leadership of the Academy of Sages, the dwarves surveyed mutated underground mineral veins everywhere, building underground fortresses to cordon off dangerous areas.

Humans were versatile, acting like bricks—moved wherever they were needed. However, they preferred registering as mercenaries to explore various forbidden zones.

Meanwhile, the isolated Abyssal demons were actively cooperating with the surface. After all, relying solely on themselves to restore the Abyssal environment would exhaust them to death, and the results would be poor.

Although the apocalypse had ended, it would take many years for the world’s mutations to recover.

During the cleanup, the City Lord of Hope City, Xia Xifeng, and Qin Lang, who had shone brightly during the initial battle of the apocalypse, lost their presence.

The reason was simple: the two of them had been lying down recuperating for five whole years before they finally rose back to the "Legendary" rank.

In the first year after deciphering the "Tombstone of the Adventura World," the two of them spent it sleeping.

Sull crafted crystal coffins for them and threw the two, who were still conscious at the time, inside to be sealed.

Leo, Perilla, and other friends of Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang came back from the battlefield specifically to visit the sick and say goodbye to their good friends, who didn't know how many years they would sleep.

They were shocked to see the silver, glowing, viscous substance covered in gray-black tentacles inside the crystal coffin.

"Don't tell me this is your divine body? Why does it look like an Evil God?" Leo said. "Can't you choose a better-looking divine body?"

The gooey and glowing Xia Xifeng replied, "I could, but this way it won't be uncomfortable to sleep on."

Leo looked at the "liquid" Xia Xifeng in the coffin and Qin Lang in his "arms," and had to admit that this form was indeed convenient for sleeping anywhere—as long as there was a jar to hold the water.

Singer, who was an Evil God in his past life, and Perilla, who was destined to become an Evil God, were deeply shocked. Meanwhile, the Hope Sun and the Water God, who had grown... several sizes larger, gave a thumbs-up to Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang’s choice. Gods of natural concepts liked such convenient and comfortable divine bodies; only gods related to humans, such as Self, Wisdom, and Evolution, preferred using human forms.

Leo’s hands were itchy, and he wanted to test the texture of the gooey Xia Xifeng.

Sull grabbed Leo by the back of his collar and threw him out the door, chasing away all the visitors and sealing off the place where Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang were healing.

Their divine bodies were shattered, and their divine fires were extinguished. Ordinary gods would have to go into seclusion for decades or even a century to stabilize their injuries. Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang broke out of seclusion in the second year.

Their cultivation dropped back to when they first entered the world; it was said they "traded experience points for a new body" and started leveling up from scratch.

However, even with new bodies, their divine souls were still injured. The two lived as ordinary people for five years, and Damon was ecstatic.

"Weak mortals, just stay in the city and work! I! The Legendary powerhouse Damon! Am heading to the battlefield!"

Damon left a note and ran away, leaving Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang buried under mountains of city affairs. Who wouldn't call that "what goes around comes around"?

Because they were so severely injured, they recovered very slowly. Five years later, they regained their Legendary status, thanks to the completion rewards of the main quest.

With the apocalypse over, the system sent a massive amount of experience and rare divine medicine, finally repairing their divine souls and allowing them to quickly ascend to the Legendary rank.

Amuro was finally able to return home in his true form.

He crossed his arms and scrutinized Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang.

Usually, people who faced the pressure of a Creator God would be left with severe psychological trauma, making it very difficult to return to their previous cultivation level.

Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had been well-protected by the Heavenly Father, so logically, they should have lacked the experience of surviving desperate situations, making this hurdle even harder for them.

Who would have thought that Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang would have no psychological trauma at all, and even flipped the Creator God the bird?

Amuro’s eyebrows twitched, and he looked at Leo and Perilla.

The two halflings shook their heads frantically.

*It wasn't me, not me. It wasn't us who taught Feng and Lang to be bad!*

"Forget it, as long as you're alive," Amuro said. "Those gods are all heavily injured; there shouldn't be another extinction crisis for a long time. You can take a long vacation."

Xia Xifeng’s eyes filled with hope. "Teacher Amuro, do you mean we don't have to be City Lords anymore?"

Amuro smiled. "No, I mean that being a City Lord is equivalent to a vacation."

Not to mention the lively and active Xia Xifeng, even Qin Lang showed a dejected expression.

Neither of them liked power; they just found the trivial matters of the city to be a real nuisance.

Damon laughed three times, calling the two "runaway City Lords" exactly what they deserved. The initial stage of Hope City was the busiest time, yet the two of them ran off together, dumping the massive city on him. Although they said they were going to save the world, their uncle could leave a clone to be City Lord; Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang, who had also ignited their divine fires, were absolutely capable of doing the same.

They were just lazy!

Damon sneered, "Now that I have ignited my divine fire and you are still Legendary, don't even think about running away again. No matter where you go, leave a clone behind to work!"

Xia Xifeng threw himself into Qin Lang’s arms and pretended to cry.

Qin Lang patted Xia Xifeng’s back, both of them suffering under Damon’s tyranny.

However, Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang still managed to run away successfully.

The final reward for the main quest, "Go Home," was issued, and they had to go home to visit their families. Although they could have left clones, they deliberately left only a letter, betting that Damon had developed such deep feelings for the Hope City he helped build that he couldn't ignore the crisis of the city being leaderless.

As for whether they would be beaten to a pulp by Damon when they returned... that was a certainty!

Qin Lang: "Why do you insist on provoking Damon?"

Xia Xifeng defended himself: "To live is to provoke everything."

Qin Lang didn't agree with Xia Xifeng, but since Xia Xifeng had already run away, he couldn't stay behind to do the work alone. They shared the trouble and the suffering; the two ran away together, and they would be beaten together upon their return.

However, Qin Lang was still kinder than Xia Xifeng; he had notified Leo and Perilla in advance to come back and help Damon share the city affairs.

Although the halflings wanted to throw a banquet every other day, they were quite efficient at working.

The poor cat butler had finally spent five years with his masters, only for them to abandon the cat and run away again.

*Why couldn't the masters take the cat with them? We can cook, run errands, and wash clothes for the masters! Cats are very capable!*

Xia Xifeng was torn between laughter and tears.

Now that there was no danger, they could indeed bring Cat One and Cat Two along when they traveled; there were plenty of rooms in the magitech car, so they wouldn't interfere with each other. But they were going back to Earth, and there were no cute, bipedal cat-people on Earth.

"Let's go, Old Qin, we're going home!"

"Mm."

...

Every summer vacation, there were reminders about drowning prevention, but tragedies still happened every year.

In Wu City, this tragedy was heart-wrenching and shook the entire nation.

Only a day after the incident, before the search and rescue had even ended, media outlets were competing to report it, and it topped the internet trending lists... whether it was the elderly who only watched TV or the young who had abandoned TV for their phones, everyone remembered one name: "Xia Xifeng."

The news of Xia Xifeng blocking a knife for a kindergarten child and subduing the perpetrator was dug up again, and no one who saw it could hold back tears for the passing of the young hero.

If a hero sacrificed themselves while trying to do good beyond their ability, it could be called tragic. But Xia Xifeng dying because a "water ghost" took his life only made people furious.

An internet celebrity had ignored warnings and ran to the middle of a shallow beach to film the dam releasing water. Xia Xifeng had almost saved the people, but the influencer pushed the exhausted Xia Xifeng toward a piece of driftwood, causing him to be knocked under the water.

There were minors playing in the water at the time. When Xia Xifeng jumped in, many people followed to save them.

When Xia Xifeng was exhausted, some people on the shore who weren't good swimmers and didn't dare to save others started a relay, entering the water to try and give Xia Xifeng a hand.

When Xia Xifeng was hit by the driftwood, many people were holding swimming rings, trying to save him, among them his good friend, Qin Lang.

chunks.chineseText:
水流湍急，下水救人的人很快上岸，沿着岸边奔跑，找寻夏兮风的踪迹。只有秦琅一直不肯上岸，和夏兮风一同失踪。

夏兮风事迹被报道时，秦琅也被提起。

连秦琅的大学同学都不知道，秦琅竟然是华国高智商俱乐部成员，立志投身理论物理，愿意为研究清贫一生，已经被某中科院大佬预定博士生。

围观群众气得把手中的瓜都砸了。

为什么水鬼不能判刑？！已经有多少见义勇为的好人被水鬼害了！！

“啊？你立志投身理论物理？”夏兮风瞠目结舌，“我怎么没听说过？”

秦琅：“我也没听说过。”

夏兮风：“那看中你的科学院大佬……”

秦琅：“俱乐部线下聚会时得到过联系方式，说想读博就找他。我说我不想读。”

夏兮风挠挠头。他就记得，秦琅根本不想动他那超高的智商搞什么理论研究，就想找一个能赚钱又轻松的研究，早点出专利，早点躺平吃专利费。

谁规定了智商高就一定要做出一番事业？秦琅一直都很懒，连玩游戏都懒得看剧情。

夏兮风唏嘘：“我还以为我们能回到活着的时候，没想到我俩身份都已经销户了。”

他们回地球时才知道，本土创世神的劳务派遣从来不派遣活人。无论是病逝意外身故还是寿终正寝，创世神只会在他们死亡前那一刻捞人丢去其他世界，不会干涉他们在原本世界的命运，破坏他们在原本世界的生活关系。

夏兮风眼睛都要哭瞎了。他真的把秦琅害死了。

神皇差点弄死他没给他留下心理阴影，他把秦琅害死的心理阴影就算超脱了都好不了。

秦琅：“还浪不浪了？”

夏兮风：“以后我路见不平一定拉你一起去，你不去我就不去！你来评定我们会不会遇到危险！”

秦琅嘴角抽了抽：“不要随便转嫁压力。”

两人嘴贫了几句，搞清楚现状后，给父母托梦，通知他们第二天待在家里别出门，他们要回来探亲。

我们没死，只是穿越啦！

“回梦世界之前，我要先杀个人。”

“哦，好。”

夏兮风一边准备催眠熏香，让两边彻夜难眠的父母倒头就睡，一边点头应道。

按照法律，他们不能这么做。但他们都死了，这是恶鬼索命，不归阳间的法律管。

“老秦啊，系统说，我们可以换个身份照顾爸妈到老，也可以帮爸妈用魔法无痛再生一个养老，后者再给我们爸妈各一千万养老钱，选哪个？”

“当然选一千万。”

“呃……”

chunks.englishText:
The current was swift, and those who went into the water to save others quickly climbed back onto the shore, running along the bank to search for signs of Xia Xifeng. Only Qin Lang refused to get out of the water, disappearing along with Xia Xifeng.

When Xia Xifeng’s deeds were reported, Qin Lang was also mentioned.

Even Qin Lang’s college classmates didn't know that Qin Lang was actually a member of a high-IQ club in China, determined to devote himself to theoretical physics, willing to live a life of poverty for research, and had already been pre-selected as a doctoral student by a big shot at the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

The onlookers were so angry they smashed the snacks they were holding.

"Why can't 'water ghosts' be prosecuted?! How many good people who tried to do good have already been harmed by water ghosts!!"

"Huh? You were determined to devote yourself to theoretical physics?" Xia Xifeng was dumbfounded. "How come I never heard of that?"

Qin Lang: "I never heard of it either."

Xia Xifeng: "Then that big shot from the Academy of Sciences who took a liking to you..."

Qin Lang: "I got his contact information during an offline club gathering; he said if I wanted to pursue a PhD, I should find him. I told him I didn't want to."

Xia Xifeng scratched his head. He only remembered that Qin Lang didn't want to use his super-high IQ for any theoretical research; he just wanted to find a job that was easy and lucrative, get patents early, and lie flat collecting patent royalties.

Who decreed that having a high IQ meant one had to achieve great things? Qin Lang had always been lazy; he was even too lazy to watch the plot in video games.

Xia Xifeng sighed, "I thought we could return to when we were alive, but I didn't expect our identities to have already been canceled."

They only found out when they returned to Earth that the local Creator God’s labor dispatch never sent living people. Whether it was death by illness, accident, or old age, the Creator God would only fish people out at the very moment of their death and throw them into other worlds; He would not interfere with their fate in their original world or disrupt their relationships in their original lives.

Xia Xifeng’s eyes were almost swollen from crying. He really had gotten Qin Lang killed.

The God-Emperor almost killing him hadn't left him with psychological trauma, but the psychological trauma of getting Qin Lang killed wouldn't go away even after transcending.

Qin Lang: "Are you going to keep acting recklessly?"

Xia Xifeng: "In the future, if I see an injustice, I'll definitely drag you along! If you don't go, I won't go! You can be the one to judge if we'll encounter danger!"

Qin Lang’s mouth twitched. "Don't shift the pressure onto me so casually."

The two bickered for a bit, and after clarifying the situation, they sent dreams to their parents, notifying them to stay home the next day and not go out, as they were coming back to visit.

*We aren't dead, we just transmigrated!*

"Before we go back to the Dream World, I want to kill someone."

"Oh, okay."

Xia Xifeng nodded while preparing hypnotic incense to let their parents, who had been sleepless all night, fall into a deep slumber.

According to the law, they couldn't do this. But they were dead; this was a vengeful ghost seeking retribution, which didn't fall under the jurisdiction of the laws of the living.

"Old Qin, the system says we can either change our identities to take care of our parents until they're old, or we can use magic to painlessly regenerate them a new life for their retirement, and the latter will also give our parents ten million each for their retirement. Which one should we choose?"

"Obviously, choose the ten million."

"Uh..."
